我们可以防御人工智能生成的针对现实世界危机事件的视频攻击吗？Can We Defend Against AI-Generated Video Attacks on Real-World Crisis Events?\对应的电子邮件\correspondingemail\预告图\teaserfigure 图1Figure 1: 哪个是哪个？Which is which?来自四种危机场景的真实片段和人工智能生成的片段并排配对；在查阅下页的答案之前，先确定每对中的综合示例。Real and AI-generated clips from four crisis scenarios are paired side by side; identify the synthetic example in each pair before consulting the answer key on the following page.

我们可以防御人工智能生成的视频吗Can We Defend Against AI-Generated Video
对现实世界危机事件的攻击？Attacks on Real-World Crisis Events?
探测器、发生器的系统评估A Systematic Evaluation of Detectors, Generators
和社会传播and Social Dissemination

摘要Abstract

最近的视频生成器可以真实地描述战争、灾难、公共紧急情况和其他现实世界的危机，从而产生巨大的错误信息风险。 然而，现有的基准提供了关于此类设置中检测器和生成器行为的有限证据，包括可检测性如何随生成条件变化、人们如何感知生成的视频以及检测器在社会传播过程中是否保持可靠。 为了解决这个差距，我们引入Recent video generators can fabricate realistic depictions of wars, disasters, public emergencies, and other real-world crises, creating substantial risks of misinformation. Existing benchmarks, however, provide limited evidence on detector and generator behavior in such settings, including how detectability varies with generation conditions, how people perceive generated videos, and whether detectors remain reliable during social dissemination. To address this gap, we introduceRA 工作台RA-Bench，人工智能生成视频检测的基准，使用, a benchmark for AI-generated video detection that usesR真实视频为eal videos asA锚点。 RA-Bench 包含 17,886 个视频，其中包括 10 个社会风险类别的 1,830 个真实视频主播，以及来自四个开源和五个闭源生成器的 16,056 个生成的剪辑。 基于RA-Bench，我们从三个维度组织我们的评估。我们首先评估七个传统检测器、三个审查设置下的十个零样本多模态模型以及两个专门针对人工智能生成的视频检测进行微调的 MLLM 的检测器泛化能力。在这些方法中，三个检测器系列都没有在 RA-Bench 实例中具有一致的泛化能力。然后我们研究可检测性如何随生成质量、条件信息和种子采样而变化。这些分析表明，生成特性对检测器系列的影响不同，而源级检测模式在种子之间保持稳定。最后，我们研究社会传播过程中人类的真实性判断和探测器的可靠性。我们发现，误导人们的视频对于当前的检测器来说也很困难，而社会传播使检测变得更加困难。总之，这些发现表明，当前的方法很难检测真实的人工智能生成的视频，这凸显了对不断发展的视频生成器稳健的检测器的需求。nchors. RA-Bench contains 17,886 videos, comprising 1,830 real-video anchors across 10 social-risk categories and 16,056 generated clips from four open-source and five closed-source generators. Based on RA-Bench, we organize our evaluation along three dimensions. We first assess detector generalization across seven traditional detectors, ten zero-shot multimodal models under three review settings, and two MLLMs specifically fine-tuned on AI-generated video detection. Across these methods, none of the three detector families generalizes consistently across RA-Bench instances. We then examine how detectability varies with generation quality, conditioning information, and sampling seeds. These analyses show that generation properties affect detector families differently, while source-level detection patterns remain stable across seeds. Finally, we study human authenticity judgments and detector reliability during social dissemination. We find that videos that mislead people are also difficult for current detectors, and that social dissemination makes detection harder. Together, these findings show that current methods struggle to detect realistic AI-generated videos, highlighting the need for detectors robust to evolving video generators.

1 简介Introduction

最近的视频生成模型Recent video generation models(Brooks et al. 2024; van den Oord and Roman 2024; Team Seedance et al. 2026)可以生成具有连贯外观和运动的越来越逼真的剪辑。通过减少创建高质量视频所需的时间和精力，这些模型可以显着提高视频制作效率。然而，这些进步也可能带来新的社会风险。例如，生成的描述战争、灾难和突发公共卫生事件等现实世界危机的视频可能会欺骗观众并引发公众恐慌。图中的例子can produce increasingly realistic clips with coherent appearance and motion. By reducing the time and effort required to create high-quality videos, these models can substantially improve video-production efficiency. However, these advances can also create new societal risks. For instance, generated videos depicting real-world crises, such as wars, disasters, and public-health emergencies, may deceive viewers and provoke public panic. The examples in Figure1强调区分生成内容和真实视频的挑战。highlight the challenge of distinguishing generated content from real videos.

为了应对这些风险，许多基准In response to these risks, numerous benchmarks(Ma et al. 2025; Chen et al. 2024; He et al. 2024)已开发用于评估现有探测器的能力have been developed to evaluate the ability of existing detectors(Wang et al. 2020; Ojha et al. 2023; Ma et al. 2025; Chen et al. 2024; Internò et al. 2025)识别真实的人工智能生成的视频。最近的基准测试扩大了生成器覆盖范围，增加了数据集规模，并引入了更全面的评估 协议to identify realistic AI-generated videos. Recent benchmarks have broadened generator coverage, increased dataset scale, and introduced more comprehensive evaluation protocols(Ma et al. 2025; Chen et al. 2024; Ni et al. 2026; Ma et al. 2026)。与此同时，其他研究通过检查法证解释、世界模拟设置和源回溯，将任务扩展到二元分类之外. Meanwhile, other studies have extended the task beyond binary classification by examining forensic explanations, world-simulation settings, and source backtracking(Wen et al. 2025a; Chen et al. 2025a; Liao et al. 2026).

然而，如表所示However, as shown in Table1，现有的研究主要集中于一般视频内容，对现实世界危机和其他重要社会影响事件背景下的探测器性能和发生器行为进行有限的系统分析。因此，, existing studies primarily focus on general video content, with limited systematic analysis of detector performance and generator behavior in the context of real-world crises and other important socially consequential events. Therefore,目前尚不清楚当前的探测器是否足够可靠，足以保护社会免受日益现实的视频生成模型和潜在滥用所造成的威胁。it remains unclear whether current detectors are sufficiently reliable to protect society from the threats posed by increasingly realistic video generation models and potential misuses.

为了解决这个问题，我们引入To tackle this problem, we introduceRA 工作台RA-Bench，人工智能生成视频检测的基准，使用, a benchmark for AI-generated video detection that usesR真实视频为eal videos asA锚点。 RA-Bench 包含从 675 个公开源视频中提取的 1,830 个真实视频主播，涵盖 10 个社会风险类别和 44 个子类别。为了模拟使用真实图像生成后续事件的合理错误信息场景，我们在每个锚点的第一帧上调节图像到视频（I2V）生成器。给定相同的第一帧和文本提示，四个开源生成器和五个闭源生成器生成 16,056 个生成的剪辑，总共产生 17,886 个视频。nchors. RA-Bench comprises 1,830 real-video anchors drawn from 675 publicly available source videos and spans 10 social-risk categories and 44 subcategories. To simulate a plausible misinformation scenario in which real image is used to generate subsequent events, we condition image-to-video (I2V) generators on the first frame of each anchor. Given the same first frame and text prompt, four open-source and five closed-source generators produce 16,056 generated clips, resulting in a total of 17,886 videos.

基于RA-Bench，我们从三个维度进行系统评估：Based on RA-Bench, we perform a systematic evaluation along three dimensions:1. 检测器概括。1. Detector Generalization.我们评估了三个检测器系列：七个传统检测器、三个审查设置下的十个零样本多模态模型，以及两个专门针对人工智能生成的视频检测进行微调的 MLLM。We evaluate three detector families: seven traditional detectors, ten zero-shot multimodal model under three review settings, and two MLLMs specifically fine-tuned for AI-generated video detection.2. 生成属性。2. We conduct a human study to identify generated videos that viewers find difficult to distinguish from real videos and specifically evaluate detectors on these human-deceptive cases, which constituteRA-工作台-HumanProofRA-Bench-HumanProof。我们进一步介绍. We further introduceRA-长凳-最后一英里RA-Bench-LastMile，用于评估探测器稳健性的社会传播模拟。, a social dissemination simulation for evaluating detector robustness.

我们的实验揭示了三个主要发现：Our experiments reveal three main findings:

On this subset, Gemini Binary and Diagnostic reach only 54.7% and 54.5% BAcc, while the seven traditional detectors average 47.5% AUC. Separately, the Full condition of the social dissemination simulation reduces mean FakeR across the five fine-tuned configurations from 46.0% to 1.4% (Section4.3).

总之，我们的研究结果表明，当前的方法仍然无法可靠地检测真实的人工智能生成的视频。当生成的内容描述现实世界的危机时，这种限制尤其重要，这凸显了随着生成模型的发展和视频在现实世界中的传播而保持有效的检测系统的需要。In conclusion, our findings demonstrate that current methods still cannot reliably detect realistic AI-generated videos. This limitation is especially consequential when generated content depicts real-world crises, highlighting the need for detection systems that remain effective as generation models evolve and videos circulate in the real world.

2 相关工作Related Work

AI 生成的视频检测基准。Benchmarks for AI-Generated Video Detection.

随着视频生成模型变得更加现实，对现有检测器是否能够准确识别人工智能生成的视频进行基准测试变得越来越重要。早期的努力，例如 GVFAs video generation models become more realistic, benchmarking whether existing detectors can accurately identify AI-generated videos has become increasingly important. Early efforts, such as GVF(Ma et al. 2025)和GenVideoand GenVideo(Chen et al. 2024)，将真实视频与生成的对应视频配对并评估跨生成器传输。后续基准测试进一步扩大了规模、生成器覆盖范围和评估协议，包括 GenVidBench, pair real videos with generated counterparts and evaluate cross-generator transfer. Subsequent benchmarks further expand the scale, generator coverage, and evaluation protocols, including GenVidBench(Ni et al. 2026)和 AIGVD 基准and AIGVDBench(Ma et al. 2026)。最近的基准测试进一步将评估范围从二元分类扩展到基于 MLLM 的解释. Recent benchmarks further extend evaluation beyond binary classification to MLLM-based explanation(Wen et al. 2025a)、世界模拟设置, world-simulation settings(Chen et al. 2025a)，以及源回溯, and source backtracking(Liao et al. 2026)。尽管取得了这些进展，现有基准在涉及现实世界危机和其他具有社会影响的事件的误用场景的覆盖范围上仍然有限。 为了解决这一差距，我们引入了 RA-Bench，并用它来系统地评估这些设置中现有探测器的稳健性和局限性。. Despite this progress, existing benchmarks remain limited in their coverage of misuse scenarios involving real-world crises and other socially consequential events. To address this gap, we introduce RA-Bench and use it to systematically assess the robustness and limitations of existing detectors in these settings.

逼真的视频生成模型。Realistic video generation models.

近年来，视频生成模型已从一个新兴的研究课题迅速发展成为一项具有重大现实和社会影响的技术。提高视频真实感长期以来一直是该领域的中心目标，从图像生成模型扩展的早期方法（例如稳定视频扩散）开始In recent years, video generation models have rapidly evolved from an emerging research topic into a technology with significant real-world and societal impact. Improving video realism has long been a central objective in this field, from early approaches extended from image generation models, such as Stable Video Diffusion(Blattmann et al. 2023)和VideoCrafterand VideoCrafter(Chen et al. 2023), 到最新的先进型号, to recent advanced models(Bar-Tal et al. 2024; Polyak et al. 2024; Kong et al. 2024; Brooks et al. 2024; van den Oord and Roman 2024; Team Wan 2025; HaCohen et al. 2025; Team Seedance et al. 2026; Cloudflare 2026)，在叙事连贯性和视觉一致性方面取得了实质性的进步。然而，发电质量的这些进步引起了人们对潜在的滥用和对社会的负面影响的担忧。这促使我们研究现有的检测方法是否能够可靠地识别日益真实的人工智能生成的视频，这可以进一步推动负责任的视频生成方法。, which have achieved substantial improvements in narrative coherence and visual consistency. However, these advances in generation quality have raised concerns about potential misuse and negative impacts on society. This motivates us to investigate whether existing detection methods can reliably identify increasingly realistic AI-generated videos, which can further push forward responsible video generation methods.

AI 生成视频的探测器。Detectors for AI-generated videos.

受到 AIGVDBench 中使用的检测器分类法的启发Inspired by the detector taxonomy used in AIGVDBench(Ma et al. 2026)，我们将现有的人工智能生成视频检测器大致分为传统的判别方法和基于 MLLM 的方法。传统方法包括视频分类模型、生成图像检测模型和生成视频检测模型。视频分类模型, we broadly divide existing AI-generated video detectors into traditional discriminative approaches and MLLM-based approaches. Traditional approaches include video classification models, generated-image detection models, and generated-video detection models. Video classification models(Feichtenhofer et al. 2019; Bertasius et al. 2021; Liu et al. 2022; Tong et al. 2022)直接将检测视为二值视频分类问题。生成图像检测器directly treat detection as a binary video classification problem. Generated-image detectors(Wang et al. 2020; Ojha et al. 2023; Tan et al. 2024; Chen et al. 2025b)主要关注图像级伪影，而生成视频检测器mainly focus on image-level artifacts, while generated-video detectors(Ma et al. 2025; He et al. 2024; Chen et al. 2024; Internò et al. 2025)进一步捕获跨帧的时间证据。除了这些传统方法之外，基于 MLLM 的检测器further capture temporal evidence across frames. Beyond these traditional approaches, MLLM-based detectors(Wen et al. 2025a; Li et al. 2025)因其可以提供二元分类结果之外的详细解释而受到越来越多的关注。在这项工作中，我们评估了现实世界危机和其他具有社会影响的事件的代表性探测器系列，并得出见解来指导其未来的设计。have gained increasing attention because they can provide detailed explanations beyond binary classification results. In this work, we evaluate representative detector families on real-world crises and other socially consequential events, and derive insights to guide their future design.

3 RA 工作台RA-Bench

与之前的基准不同Unlike prior benchmarks(Ma et al. 2026; Wen et al. 2025a)，从通用网络视频语料库（例如 OpenVid-1M）收集种子视频数据, which collect seed video data from general-purpose web video corpora such as OpenVid-1M(Nan et al. 2025)，RA-Bench 专注于现实世界危机和其他具有社会影响的事件的真实视频，其中伪造的视频可能会带来公共风险。我们首先收集公共源视频并将其组织成社会风险类别（第, RA-Bench focuses on real videos from real-world crises and other socially consequential events, where forged videos can pose public risk. We first collect public source videos and organize them into social-risk categories (Section3.1）。然后，每个源视频被分割成场景级剪辑并筛选近似重复的内容（第). Then, each source video is segmented into scene-level clips and screened for near-duplicates (Section3.2）。生成的剪辑通过两轮人工审核进行过滤（第). The resulting clips are filtered through two rounds of human review (Section3.3），之后后处理将保留的剪辑标准化为最终的锚点集（第), after which postprocessing standardizes the retained clips into the final anchor set (Section3.4）。然后将每个真实剪辑与图像到视频生成的剪辑配对，形成基准的生成部分（第 1 节）). Each real clip is then paired with image-to-video generated clips that form the generated side of the benchmark (Section3.5）。生成的 RA-Bench 包含 1,830 个真实视频剪辑和 16,056 个生成剪辑。施工管线概况如图). The resulting RA-Bench consists of 1,830 real-video clips and 16,056 generated clips. An overview of the construction pipeline is shown in Figure2，基准组成总结如图, and the benchmark composition is summarized in Figure3.

3.1 源数据收集Source Data Collection

为了准备构建基准的源数据，我们首先从公共平台收集了 675 个描述现实世界危机和其他具有社会影响的事件的视频。然后，我们将这些视频分为 10 个社会风险类别 (L1) 和 44 个子类别 (L2)。 L1类别包括天气和自然灾害、战争和武装冲突、政治和治理、公共安全、事故和基础设施故障、经济和社会恐慌、公共卫生、技术、太空和探索以及大型公共活动。 L2 类别的详细信息请参阅附录To prepare source data for constructing the benchmark, we first collect 675 videos depicting real-world crises and other socially consequential events from public platforms. We then group these videos into 10 social-risk categories (L1) and 44 subcategories (L2). The L1 categories are weather and natural disasters, war and armed conflict, politics and governance, public safety, accidents and infrastructure failures, economic and social panic, public health, technology, space and exploration, and large public events. Details of the L2 categories are provided in AppendixA.1。我们不会对每个类别实行统一的配额，因为相同大小的配额会扭曲社会风险场景的自然流行程度，并使样本偏离实际的部署条件。 L1分类及发布类别分布如图. We do not impose a uniform per-category quota, since equal-size quotas would distort the natural prevalence of social-risk scenes and move the sample away from realistic deployment conditions. The L1 taxonomy and the released category distribution are shown in Figure3（一，二）。(a,b).

在收集的视频源中，政府和公共机构帐户构成最大的群体，而开放许可存储库（Among the collected video sources, government and public-institution accounts form the largest group, while open-license repositories (例如e.g.维基共享资源）和公共视频平台（Wikimedia Commons) and public video platforms (例如e.g.YouTube）占据了其余来源的大部分。附录YouTube) account for most of the remaining sources. AppendixA.2列出用于数据收集的来源。由于不同来源的许可条件各不相同，因此我们记录每个来源的再分发权利，并在第 5 节中描述的权利检查中使用此信息lists the sources used for data collection. Since licensing conditions vary across sources, we record the redistribution rights for each source and use this information in the rights check described in Section3.4.

3.2 自动预处理Automated Preprocessing

我们将每个源视频分割成场景级剪辑，以便稍后查看和生成图像到视频。具体来说，我们使用 PySceneDetect 检测场景切换We segment each source video into scene-level clips for later review and image-to-video generation. Specifically, we detect scene cuts with PySceneDetect11 1 https://www.scenedetect.com/docs/latest/并使用 FFmpeg 在这些剪辑处分割视频and split the videos at these cuts using FFmpeg22 2 https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.html，从 675 个源视频中生成 5,774 个可审查的剪辑。由于源视频中的相邻场景往往共享相似的帧和内容，因此我们在剪辑池上运行近乎重复的预过滤器。我们采用 ResNet-18, producing 5,774 reviewable clips from 675 source videos. Since adjacent scenes in a source video tend to share similar framing and content, we run a near-duplicate prefilter on the clip pool. We adopt a ResNet-18(He et al. 2016)在 ImageNet-1K 上预训练pretrained on ImageNet-1K(Russakovsky et al. 2015)对每个剪辑进行编码并比较同一源视频中相邻剪辑之间的余弦相似度。当帧级和剪辑级相似度都超过指定阈值时，将标记对，并且在手动审核期间，标记对将作为重复警告显示给审阅者（第 1 节）to encode each clip and compare cosine similarities between neighboring clips from the same source video. A pair is flagged when both frame- and clip-level similarities exceed the specified thresholds, and flagged pairs are shown to reviewers as duplicate warnings during manual review (Section3.3）。附录中提供了预处理的更多详细信息). More details of the preprocessing are provided in AppendixA.3.

3.3 人工审核Manual Review

我们对预处理后获得的 5,774 个剪辑进行了两轮手动审核。在第一轮中，七名志愿者使用预定义的视觉质量评估标准、指定子类别的语义匹配度、持续时间适宜性、重复内容和来源相关风险来审查剪辑。每个剪辑均由两名审阅者独立评估，他们分配以下三个操作之一：We conduct a two-round manual review of the 5,774 clips obtained after preprocessing. In Round 1, seven volunteers review the clips using predefined evaluation criteria for visual quality, semantic fit to the assigned subcategory, duration suitability, duplicate content, and source-related risks. Each clip is independently assessed by two reviewers, who assign one of three actions:保留retain, 拒绝reject, 或, or不确定的uncertain。审稿人意见不一致的剪辑和标记为不确定的剪辑将进入第 2 轮。在第 2 轮中，另外四名志愿者担任评审员，并对每个发送的剪辑做出最终决定。经过此过程后，将保留 2,426 个片段作为标准样本池，并拒绝 3,348 个片段。附录中提供了手动审核流程的更多详细信息. Clips with reviewer disagreement and those marked as uncertain are routed to Round 2. In Round 2, another four volunteers serve as adjudicators and make the final decision for each routed clip. After this process, 2,426 clips are retained as the standard sample pool and 3,348 are rejected. Further details of the manual review process are provided in AppendixA.4.

3.4 保留剪辑后处理Retained Clip Postprocessing

我们使用时长限制、编码统一、同质性修剪和许可审查对 2,426 个保留剪辑进行后处理，以获得最终的真实视频集。具体来说，我们首先将每个剪辑绑定到 3-15 秒的窗口，丢弃短于 3 秒的剪辑并截断较长的剪辑，从而保持适度的剪辑持续时间，平衡足够的信息和检测模型可接受的成本。然后，我们使用 H.264 重新编码每个剪辑，然后将相同的编码应用于生成的剪辑。这降低了检测器依赖编解码器配置作为标签提示的风险。随后，我们删除从每个源视频中提取的冗余剪辑，以减少同一事件的近似重复。最后，我们审查源级许可条件并将由此产生的再分发权记录为每个剪辑的元数据。经过这些操作，最终集包含来自 338 个独特源视频的 1,830 个剪辑，总计 18,448 秒（约 5.1 小时），平均持续时间为 10.08 秒。发布集的类别构成如图We postprocess the 2,426 retained clips to obtain the final real video set, using duration bounding, encoding unification, homogeneity pruning, and licensing review. Specifically, we first bound each clip to a 3–15 seconds window, discarding clips shorter than 3 seconds and truncating longer ones, thereby maintaining a moderate clip duration that balances sufficient information and acceptable cost for detection models. We then re-encode every clip with H.264 and later apply the same encoding to the generated clips. This reduces the risk that detectors rely on codec configurations as label cues. Subsequently, we remove redundant clips extracted from each source video to reduce near-duplicates from the same event. Finally, we review source-level licensing conditions and record the resulting redistribution rights as metadata for each clip. After these operations, the final set contains 1,830 clips from 338 unique source videos, totaling 18,448 s (about 5.1 hours) with a mean duration of 10.08 s. The category composition of the released set is shown in Figure3(b).附录中提供了进一步的后处理详细信息(b). Further postprocessing details are provided in AppendixA.5.

3.5 配对视频生成Paired Video Generation

我们使用统一的生成管道将每个真实剪辑与图像到视频（I2V）模型生成的对应剪辑配对，如图所示We pair each real clip with counterparts generated by image-to-video (I2V) models using a unified generation pipeline, as shown in Figure4。在这种设计下，每个真实剪辑及其生成的对应内容共享相同的场景语义，并以现实世界的危机和其他具有社会影响的事件为基础。. Under this design, each real clip and its generated counterparts share the same scene semantics and are grounded in real-world crises and other socially consequential events.

我们首先使用 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 为每个真实剪辑添加字幕We first caption each real clip with Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview(Google 2026)，遵循结构化视频字幕实践, following structured video-captioning practice(Ju et al. 2024; Luo et al. 2025)，并将标题转换为所有生成器共享的提示（附录, and convert the caption into a prompt shared across all generators (AppendixA.6）。然后，我们根据获得的标题和真实剪辑的第一帧来调节每个生成器。这种设计产生视觉上合理的生成剪辑，增加了基准难度，并反映了一种常见的社交媒体操纵场景，其中来自现实世界危机或其他具有社会影响的事件的静态图像被用来制作可能构成公共风险的视频。最后，我们将生成的视频长度设置为与相应真实剪辑的持续时间成正比，同时将其限制在 2-8 秒的范围内。每个生成器都会将此目标映射到支持的持续时间设置，以便每个生成的剪辑都保持在大多数现有视频生成模型支持的范围内，如附录中详述). We then condition each generator on the obtained caption and the first frame of the real clip. This design yields visually plausible generated clips, increases benchmark difficulty, and reflects a common social media manipulation scenario in which a still image from a real-world crisis or another socially consequential event is used to fabricate a video that may pose public risk. Finally, we set the generated video length proportional to the duration of the corresponding real clip while constraining it to a 2–8 s range. Each generator maps this target to a supported duration setting so that every generated clip remains within the range supported by most existing video generation models, as detailed in AppendixA.6。这种动态持续时间设置有助于评估检测模型是否学习基于持续时间的快捷方式。. This dynamic duration setting helps assess whether detection models learn duration-based shortcuts.

生成后，我们使用与真实剪辑相同的 H.264 编解码器对每个生成的剪辑进行重新编码。我们保留每个生成器的原始分辨率和帧速率，并从所有剪辑中删除音频。我们使用四个开源生成器和五个闭源生成器生成剪辑，如图所示After generation, we re-encode every generated clip using the same H.264 codec as the real clips. We preserve each generator’s native resolution and frame rate, and remove audio from all clips. We generate clips with four open-source and five closed-source generators, as shown in Figure3（三）。四个开源生成器覆盖了全部 1,830 个主播。我们向每个闭源提供商提交相同的锚点，但特定于提供商的内容安全过滤器拒绝一些请求，从而导致较小的配对子集。 RA-Bench 总共包含 16,056 个生成的剪辑。(c). The four open-source generators cover all 1,830 anchors. We submit the same anchors to each closed-source provider, but provider-specific content-safety filters reject some requests, resulting in smaller paired subsets. In total, RA-Bench contains 16,056 generated clips.

4 实验与分析Experiments and Analysis

我们评估了当前在 RA-Bench 上检测 AI 生成视频的方法，并分析了与检测难度相关的因素。我们的实验涵盖了 RA-Bench 中的所有四个开源生成器和五个闭源生成器；生成器和配对剪辑计数总结于图中We evaluate current methods for detecting AI-generated video on RA-Bench and analyze the factors associated with detection difficulty. Our experiments cover all four open-source and five closed-source generators in RA-Bench; the generators and paired clip counts are summarized in Figure3（三）。每个开源生成器都会根据 1,830 个生成的剪辑及其匹配的真实锚点进行评估。对于闭源生成器，提供者端审核可以减少覆盖范围，因此每个生成器都会根据返回的生成剪辑及其相应的真实锚点进行评估。为了检查对生成持续时间的敏感性，第 1 节中的检测器端实验(c). Each open-source generator is evaluated on 1,830 generated clips and their matched real anchors. For closed-source generators, provider-side moderation can reduce coverage, so each is evaluated on the returned generated clips and their corresponding real anchors. To examine sensitivity to generation duration, the detector-side experiments in Section4.1另外还包括固定持续时间的 Wan2.2 变体作为动态持续时间生成的控制。我们用星号标记此辅助控制，并将其从所有基准水平平均值中排除。对于连续的假分数，我们报告配对的 AUC 和 TPR@5%FPR；对于离散决策，我们报告平衡准确率 (BAcc)、宏观 F1 和假召回率 (FakeR)。我们的分析分为三个部分。我们首先评估传统检测器、零样本多模态模型和针对 AI 生成视频检测进行微调的 MLLM 是否可以跨生成源泛化（第 1 节）additionally include a fixed-duration Wan2.2 variant as a control for dynamic-duration generation. We mark this auxiliary control with an asterisk and exclude it from all benchmark-level averages. For continuous fake scores, we report paired AUC and TPR@5%FPR; for discrete decisions, we report balanced accuracy (BAcc), macro-F1, and fake recall (FakeR). Our analysis has three parts. We first evaluate whether traditional detectors, zero-shot multimodal models, and MLLMs fine-tuned for AI-generated video detection generalize across generation sources (Section4.1）。然后，我们研究生成质量、条件信息和种子采样与可检测性的关系（第 1 节）). We then examine how generation quality, conditioning information, and sampling seeds relate to detectability (Section4.2）。最后，我们将检测器的行为与人类的真实性判断进行比较，并评估检测器在社会传播过程中的鲁棒性（第). Finally, we compare detector behavior with human authenticity judgments and evaluate detector robustness during social dissemination (Section4.3）。评估实施细节总结于附录). Reallocating the same frames recovers some local temporal evidence, but it does not change the central result: high public-reference AUC neither translates into reliable detection nor identifies a consistently strong detector across RA-Bench sources.

4.1.3 微调 MLLM 表现出协议依赖性和类别偏差Fine-Tuned MLLMs Exhibit Protocol Dependence and Class Bias

在官方时间戳提示下，Skyra-SFT 和 Skyra-RL 在 RA-Bench 上分别达到源相等的平均 BAcc 值 68.5% 和 69.5%（表Under the official-timestamp prompt, Skyra-SFT and Skyra-RL reach source-equal mean BAcc values of 68.5% and 69.5%, respectively, on RA-Bench (Table4）。这些方法并不表明跨源检测的一致性：Skyra-SFT 的 FakeR 范围为 16.4% 到 73.3%，Skyra-RL 的范围为 20.2% 到 78.9%。 BusterX++ 表现出不同的故障模式。其FakeR保持在4.1%至9.1%之间，而其宏观F1保持在36.1%至40.8%之间。连同其 93.0–93.8% 的真实召回率，该模式表明人们对). These means do not indicate consistent cross-source detection: FakeR ranges from 16.4% to 73.3% for Skyra-SFT and from 20.2% to 78.9% for Skyra-RL. BusterX+​+ exhibits a different failure mode. Its FakeR remains between 4.1% and 9.1%, while its macro-F1 remains between 36.1% and 40.8%. Together with its 93.0–93.8% real recall, this pattern indicates a strong preference for the真实Real类而不是生成视频的可靠识别。因此，经过评估的微调系统表现出明显的弱点：Skyra 的源敏感检测和 BusterX++ 的强烈类别偏差。class rather than reliable recognition of generated videos. The evaluated fine-tuned systems therefore exhibit distinct weaknesses: source-sensitive detection for Skyra and a strong class bias for BusterX+​+.

固定持续时间控制揭示了 Skyra 官方时间戳结果中的另一个异常情况。 Wan2.2动态及其固定持续时间控制使用相同的生成器、锚点、提示和第一帧调节，以持续时间策略作为受控差异。将持续时间固定在大约 5 秒，Skyra-SFT 的 FakeR 从 33.8% 增加到 96.4%，Skyra-RL 的 FakeR 从 38.2% 增加到 97.7%。 RA-Bench 中出现了相关模式。在八个 RA-Bench 生成源中，包括以 5.00 秒结束的剪辑和具有其他最终时间戳的剪辑，前者获得的 FakeR 明显更高；来源平等差距分别为 48.6 点和 43.4 点。这些比较揭示了显示的时间网格和 Skyra 的预测之间的紧密关联，但它们并不能确定差异是来自依赖于持续时间的视觉内容还是来自时间标签本身。The fixed-duration control reveals an additional anomaly in Skyra’s official-timestamp results. Wan2.2 dynamic and its fixed-duration control use the same generator, anchors, prompts, and first-frame conditioning, with duration policy as the controlled difference. Fixing the duration at approximately 5 seconds increases FakeR from 33.8% to 96.4% for Skyra-SFT and from 38.2% to 97.7% for Skyra-RL. A related pattern appears within RA-Bench. Across the eight RA-Bench generation sources that include clips ending at exactly 5.00 seconds and clips with other final timestamps, the former receive substantially higher FakeR; the source-equal gaps are 48.6 and 43.4 points, respectively. These comparisons reveal a strong association between the displayed temporal grid and Skyra’s predictions, but they do not determine whether the difference arises from duration-dependent visual content or from the temporal labels themselves.

为了区分这些解释，我们用帧索引替换绝对时间戳，同时保留相同的 16 个视觉帧及其顺序。这一干预措施将 Skyra-SFT 的精确 5 秒 FakeR 差距从 48.6 分减少到 1.5 分，将 Skyra-RL 从 43.4 分减少到 1.4 分。平均 BAcc 也分别从 68.5% 下降至 54.4%，从 69.5% 下降至 54.9%。由于视觉输入不变，时间网格间隙的崩溃表明对时间标签表示的强烈敏感性。对已发布的 ViF 元数据的审核To distinguish these explanations, we replace absolute timestamps with frame indices while preserving the same 16 visual frames and their order. This intervention reduces the exact-5-second FakeR gap from 48.6 to 1.5 points for Skyra-SFT and from 43.4 to 1.4 points for Skyra-RL. Mean BAcc also falls from 68.5% to 54.4% and from 69.5% to 54.9%, respectively. Because the visual input is unchanged, the collapse of the temporal-grid gap identifies a strong sensitivity to temporal-label representation. An audit of the released ViF metadata(Li et al. 2025)进一步表明，精确的 5 秒最终时间戳与类标签相关，为该协议之前提供了一个合理的来源（附录further shows that an exact-5-second final timestamp is correlated with the class label, providing a plausible source of this protocol prior (AppendixB.4).

删除时间戳并不能恢复稳定的基于内容的检测。在帧索引下，Skyra-SFT 的每源 BAcc 仍为 31.1-61.0%，Skyra-RL 的每源 BAcc 仍为 29.7-61.3%（图Removing timestamps does not recover stable content-based detection. Under frame indices, per-source BAcc still spans 31.1–61.0% for Skyra-SFT and 29.7–61.3% for Skyra-RL (Figure8）。因此，时间标签解释了 Skyra 行为的一个重要组成部分，但并不能解释所有代源之间的变化。 RL 微调既不会消除协议依赖性，也不会消除剩余的特定于源的故障。). Temporal labels therefore explain an important component of Skyra’s behavior, but not all variation across generation sources. RL fine-tuning removes neither the protocol dependence nor the remaining source-specific failures.

对于微调的 MLLM，用帧索引替换时间戳会将 Skyra 的平均 BAcc 降低到 54.4–54.9%，而 BusterX++ 仅达到 4.1–9.1% FakeR。For the fine-tuned MLLMs, replacing timestamps with frame indices lowers Skyra to 54.4–54.9% mean BAcc, while BusterX+​+ reaches only 4.1–9.1% FakeR.

4.1.4 探测器概括总结Summary of Detector Generalization

在所有三个探测器系列中，性能无法在 RA-Bench 源之间一致地传递。传统检测器的 AUC 从公开参考文献中的 67.6-98.6% 下降到 RA-Bench 上的源级平均值 43.9-57.3%，不同的检测器在不同的生成器上领先。零样本多模态模型的缩放参数并不能消除它们对提示格式或生成源的敏感性。对于微调的 MLLM，用帧索引替换时间戳会将 Skyra 的平均 BAcc 降低到 54.4–54.9%，而 BusterX++ 仅达到 4.1–9.1% FakeR。因此，公共基准性能、更大的模型规模和特定于任务的微调本身并不能确保跨生成源的泛化。Across all three detector families, performance fails to transfer consistently across RA-Bench sources. Traditional detector AUC falls from 67.6–98.6% in public references to source-level means of 43.9–57.3% on RA-Bench, with different detectors leading on different generators. Scaling parameters of zero-shot multimodal models does not remove their sensitivity to prompt format or generation source. For the fine-tuned MLLMs, replacing timestamps with frame indices lowers Skyra to 54.4–54.9% mean BAcc, while BusterX+​+ reaches only 4.1–9.1% FakeR. Public benchmark performance, larger model scale, and task-specific fine-tuning therefore do not by themselves ensure generalization across generation sources.

4.2 是什么使得生成的视频难以检测？What Makes Generated Videos Hard to Detect?

4.2.1 生成质量并不能统一决定检测难度Generation Quality Does Not Uniformly Determine Detection Difficulty

我们使用已发布的 VBench++ I2V 评估器评估 RA-Bench 中生成的所有 16,056 个剪辑We evaluate all 16,056 generated clips in RA-Bench using the released VBench++ I2V evaluators(Huang et al. 2025)。我们报告了三个总得分：官方的 VBench-I2V 质量得分，它结合了时间一致性、运动和逐帧质量的六个维度；条件保真度，定义为标准化视频图像主题和背景一致性分数的平均值；以及综合质量，它们的等权均值。我们省略相机运动，因为 RA-Bench 提示未指定该评估器所需的受控相机运动标签。为了将剪辑级别的质量变化与生成源之间的差异分开，我们估计每个源内的关联。我们进一步按动态程度对剪辑进行分层，因为低运动剪辑只需进行少量更改即可获得高时间一致性分数。对于每个连续质量得分，我们报告与四分位数增加相关的假侧检测器输出的调整后的变化，给予每个源相同的权重。这些估计描述了 RA-Bench 内的关联，而不是因果效应。图. We report three aggregate scores: the official VBench-I2V Quality Score, which combines six dimensions of temporal consistency, motion, and frame-wise quality; Condition Fidelity, defined as the mean of the normalized Video–Image Subject and Background Consistency scores; and Combined Quality, their equal-weight mean. We omit Camera Motion because RA-Bench prompts do not specify the controlled camera-motion labels required by that evaluator. To separate clip-level quality variation from differences among generation sources, we estimate associations within each source. We further stratify clips by Dynamic Degree because low-motion clips can receive high temporal-consistency scores simply by changing little. For each continuous quality score, we report the adjusted change in fake-side detector output associated with an interquartile increase, giving each source equal weight. These estimates describe associations within RA-Bench rather than causal effects. Figure9呈现结果，附录中提供了完整的评分和统计详细信息presents the results, with full scoring and statistical details provided in AppendixC.1.

图中的三个 Gemini 输出和传统探测器均值Across the three Gemini outputs and the traditional-detector mean in Figure9(a)，所有三个总分的较高值与较弱的虚假证据相关。对于 Gemini Diagnostic，VBench-I2V 质量得分、条件保真度和综合质量的四分位间增加分别与虚假召回率下降 9.6、14.4 和 12.4 个百分点相关。条件保真度对双子座二元和评级也有最大的负面关联。传统检测器的三个分数平均值下降了 9.5-11.5 个百分点，其中最大的变化与 VBench-I2V 质量分数相关。因此，没有一个单一的总分可以一致地表征跨探测器系列的探测难度。(a), higher values of all three aggregate scores are associated with weaker fake evidence. For Gemini Diagnostic, an interquartile increase in the VBench-I2V Quality Score, Condition Fidelity, and Combined Quality is associated with decreases of 9.6, 14.4, and 12.4 percentage points in fake recall, respectively. Condition Fidelity also has the largest negative association for Gemini Binary and Rating. The traditional-detector mean decreases by 9.5–11.5 percentile points across the three scores, with its largest change associated with the VBench-I2V Quality Score. No single aggregate score therefore characterizes detection difficulty consistently across detector families.

维度级别的结果解释了这种差异。对于 Gemini Diagnostic，较高的视频图像主题和背景一致性以及较高的视频内主题和背景一致性均与虚假召回率下降 13.2-14.9 个百分点相关。运动平滑度显示出 7.9 个百分点的较小下降，而美学质量和成像质量与诊断结论没有明显关联。传统检测器平均值遵循不同的模式：主体一致性和成像质量显示出最大的下降，分别为 10.1 和 9.4 个百分位点，而运动平滑度仅将其改变The dimension-level results explain this difference. For Gemini Diagnostic, higher Video–Image Subject and Background Consistency and higher within-video Subject and Background Consistency are each associated with 13.2–14.9 percentage-point decreases in fake recall. Motion Smoothness shows a smaller decrease of 7.9 percentage points, while Aesthetic Quality and Imaging Quality show no clear association with the Diagnostic verdict. The traditional-detector mean follows a different pattern: Subject Consistency and Imaging Quality show the largest decreases, at 10.1 and 9.4 percentile points, respectively, while Motion Smoothness changes it by only−2.1-2.1点。因此，Gemini 诊断与条件保真度和时间一致性最密切相关，而传统检测器平均值也随帧级成像质量变化很大。points. Gemini Diagnostic is thus most closely associated with Condition Fidelity and temporal consistency, whereas the traditional-detector mean also varies strongly with frame-level Imaging Quality.

动态度进一步说明了为什么发电质量不能被视为单一轴。在调整生成源和匹配的真实视频锚点后，动态剪辑在三个 Gemini 输出中比静态剪辑接收到的假证据多 5.5-8.4 点。传统检测器平均值仅变化 0.1 个百分位数，且其 95% 置信区间跨度为零。由于动态度对 VBench-I2V 质量得分有正向贡献，因此这种关联部分抵消了其一致性维度的负面关联，并有助于解释为什么质量得分与 Gemini 的负面关联比条件保真度的负面关联更弱。总的来说，条件保真度和时间一致性与较弱的假证据相关，而动态剪辑与较强的 Gemini 假证据相关，并且传统检测器均值没有明显变化。因此，检测难度取决于质量维度和所评估的检测器系列。Dynamic Degree further shows why generation quality cannot be treated as a single axis. After adjustment for generation source and matched real-video anchor, dynamic clips receive 5.5–8.4 points more fake evidence than static clips across the three Gemini outputs. The traditional-detector mean changes by only 0.1 percentile points, and its 95% confidence interval spans zero. Because Dynamic Degree contributes positively to the VBench-I2V Quality Score, this association partly offsets the negative associations of its consistency dimensions and helps explain why the Quality Score has a weaker negative association with Gemini than Condition Fidelity. Taken together, Condition Fidelity and temporal consistency are associated with weaker fake evidence, whereas dynamic clips are associated with stronger Gemini fake evidence and no clear change in the traditional-detector mean. Detection difficulty therefore depends on both the quality dimension and the detector family being evaluated.

外卖。Takeaway.

在源中，较强的条件保真度和时间一致性与生成的类的较弱证据相关，而动态内容增强了 Gemini 的虚假证据，但使传统检测器的平均值几乎保持不变。Within sources, stronger Condition Fidelity and temporal consistency are associated with weaker evidence for the generated class, whereas dynamic content strengthens Gemini’s fake evidence but leaves the traditional-detector mean nearly unchanged.

4.2.2 真实图像调节对探测器系列的影响不同Real-Image Conditioning Affects Detector Families Differently

RA-Bench 在其匹配的真实视频锚点的第一帧上调节每个生成的视频。为了检查不同数量的真实图像条件下的检测器行为，我们使用 Wan2.2 在三种设置下生成相同的 1,830 个锚点衍生提示：T2V、第一帧 I2V 和第一帧 + 最后帧 I2V。 T2V 仅接收提示，而两个 I2V 设置另外接收匹配的第一帧或匹配的第一帧和最后一帧。我们报告了七个传统检测器和五种针对 AI 生成视频检测进行微调的 MLLM 设置的种子 0 结果：Skyra-SFT 和 Skyra-RL 的官方时间戳和帧索引提示，以及已发布的 BusterX++ 管道。表RA-Bench conditions each generated video on the first frame of its matched real-video anchor. To examine detector behavior under different amounts of real-image conditioning, we use Wan2.2 to generate the same 1,830 anchor-derived prompts under three settings: T2V, first-frame I2V, and first+last-frame I2V. T2V receives only the prompt, whereas the two I2V settings additionally receive the matched first frame or the matched first and last frames. We report seed-0 results for the seven traditional detectors and five settings of MLLMs fine-tuned for AI-generated video detection: official-timestamp and frame-index prompts for Skyra-SFT and Skyra-RL, and the released BusterX+​+ pipeline. 从 T2V 到第一帧 I2V，七个检测器的平均 AUC 从 33.4% 增加到 50.9%，其中七个传统检测器中的五个 AUC 更高。在相同的比较中，五个微调 MLLM 设置的平均 FakeR 从 70.5% 下降到 42.7%，并且每个设置都显示出 21.0-32.2 点的下降。因此，两个探测器系列对第一帧调节的响应方向相反。From T2V to first-frame I2V, the seven-detector mean AUC increases from 33.4% to 50.9%, with higher AUC for five of the seven traditional detectors. Over the same comparison, the mean FakeR across the five fine-tuned MLLM settings decreases from 70.5% to 42.7%, and every setting shows a decrease of 21.0–32.2 points. The two detector families therefore respond in opposite directions to first-frame conditioning.

从第一帧到第一帧+最后一帧 I2V，FakeR 在四种 Skyra 设置中下降了 15.6-19.3 点，所有五种微调 MLLM 设置的平均值从 42.7% 下降到 28.3%。 BusterX+++ FakeR 从 6.0% 下降至 4.0%；其较小的变化反映了已经很低的 FakeR，而不是稳定的检测。两种 Skyra 提示格式都遵循相同的方向，表明下降并非特定于时间标签格式。From first-frame to first+last-frame I2V, FakeR decreases by 15.6–19.3 points across the four Skyra settings, and the mean across all five fine-tuned MLLM settings falls from 42.7% to 28.3%. BusterX+​+ FakeR decreases from 6.0% to 4.0%; its smaller change reflects the already low FakeR rather than stable detection. Both Skyra prompt formats follow the same direction, showing that the decline is not specific to the temporal-label format.

For Skyra under the official-timestamp prompts and for BusterX+​+, the FakeR decrease from first-frame to first+last-frame I2V persists across all three seeds (AppendixC.2）。因此，生成设置不会给探测器系列带来共同的排序困难：对于微调的 MLLM，更多的真实图像调节与逐渐降低的 FakeR 相关，而传统探测器的 AUC 在探测器特定方向上发生变化。). Generation settings therefore do not impose a shared difficulty ordering across detector families: more real-image conditioning is associated with progressively lower FakeR for the fine-tuned MLLMs, whereas traditional-detector AUC changes in detector-specific directions.

发电质量和调节对探测器系列的影响不同。在源中，较强的条件保真度和时间一致性与生成的类的较弱证据相关，而动态内容增强了 Gemini 的虚假证据，但使传统检测器的平均值几乎保持不变。在 T2V、第一帧 I2V 和第一帧+最后帧 I2V 中，针对 AI 生成的视频检测进行微调的评估 MLLM 的平均 FakeR 从 70.5% 下降到 42.7% 和 28.3%，而传统检测器 AUC 则在两个方向上移动。在三个测试的种子中，源级七检测器平均 AUC 和微调 MLLM FakeR 仅略有不同。Generation quality and conditioning affect detector families differently. Within sources, stronger Condition Fidelity and temporal consistency are associated with weaker evidence for the generated class, whereas dynamic content strengthens Gemini’s fake evidence but leaves the traditional-detector mean nearly unchanged. Across T2V, first-frame I2V, and first+last-frame I2V, the mean FakeR of the evaluated MLLMs fine-tuned for AI-generated video detection falls from 70.5% to 42.7% and 28.3%, while traditional-detector AUCs move in both directions. Across the three tested seeds, the source-level seven-detector mean AUC and fine-tuned MLLM FakeR vary only slightly.

4.3 人类感知与社会传播Human Perception and Social Dissemination

4.3.1 不同世代来源的人类认知差异很大Human Recognition Varies Sharply Across Generation Sources

生成的视频是否会误导观众是其社会风险的核心，但探测器的性能本身并不能衡量人类的识别能力。因此，我们在 RA-Bench 上进行了源未知的人类评估。二十名审阅者按照审阅者特定的随机顺序检查视频，并在其中进行选择Whether generated videos can mislead viewers is central to their societal risk, but detector performance alone does not measure human recognition. We therefore conduct a source-unaware human evaluation on RA-Bench. Twenty reviewers inspect videos in reviewer-specific randomized orders and choose among真实Real, 不确定Uncertain, 和, and生成Generated，来自不同来源的真实视频和生成视频交错。初步分析中的每个视频都会接受三个独立的判断。审稿人将 60.3% 的生成视频判断标记为, with real and generated videos from different sources interleaved. Each video in the primary analysis receives three independent judgments. Reviewers label 60.3% of generated-video judgments as生成Generated。真实视频被更频繁地识别，71.9%的判断被标记. Real videos are recognized more often, with 71.9% of judgments labeled真实Real;然而，22.8% 被标记为; however, 22.8% are labeled生成Generated和 5.3%and 5.3%不确定Uncertain。因此，描述危机事件的真实视频也可能被误认为是生成的内容。. Real videos depicting crisis events can therefore also be mistaken for generated content.

4.3.2 RA-Bench-HumanProof 在探测器系列中仍然很困难RA-Bench-HumanProof Remains Difficult Across Detector Families

我们构建We constructRA-工作台-HumanProofRA-Bench-HumanProof通过两个阶段。在标准审核流中生成的 16,038 个视频中，第 1 阶段保留了所有三位指定审核者都标记的 1,080 个视频through two stages. Of the 16,038 generated videos in the standard review stream, Stage 1 retains 1,080 that all three assigned reviewers label真实Real。另外两名审稿人使用相同的源未知协议独立重新评估这些候选者，并且仅当两者再次标记时才保留视频. Two additional reviewers independently reassess these candidates using the same source-unaware protocol, and a video is retained only when both again label it真实Real。因此，生成的 633 个视频已被标记为. The resulting 633 generated videos have therefore been labeled真实Real由所有五位审稿人。 RA-Bench-HumanProof 包含 119 个开源视频和 514 个闭源视频，其中 160 个来自 Kling，159 个来自 Seedance2.0。by all five reviewers. RA-Bench-HumanProof contains 119 open-source and 514 closed-source videos, including 160 from Kling and 159 from Seedance2.0.

七个传统检测器在 RA-Bench-HumanProof 上的平均 AUC 和 4.4% T@5%，而在源匹配 RA-Bench 加权下分别为 49.5% 和 4.6%。这种有限的变化并不意味着可靠的检测：两种评估仍然接近随机排名，并且以 5% 的误报率提供很少的生成视频召回率。 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 与人类困难表现出更清晰的关联。二进制和诊断 BAcc 从 61.2% 和 61.0% 下降到 54.7% 和 54.5%，而 FakeR 分别从 49.9% 和 47.3% 下降到 34.3% 和 30.0%。评级AUC从61.5%下降到54.9%，T@5%从5.6%下降到4.3%。The seven traditional detectors average 47.5% AUC and 4.4% T@5% on RA-Bench-HumanProof, compared with 49.5% and 4.6% under source-matched RA-Bench weighting. This limited change does not imply reliable detection: both evaluations remain close to random ranking and provide little generated-video recall at a 5% false-positive rate. Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview exhibits a clearer association with human difficulty. Binary and Diagnostic BAcc decrease from 61.2% and 61.0% to 54.7% and 54.5%, while their FakeR decreases from 49.9% and 47.3% to 34.3% and 30.0%, respectively. Rating AUC decreases from 61.5% to 54.9%, and its T@5% decreases from 5.6% to 4.3%.

经过微调的 MLLM 相对于其源匹配参考最多改变 2.4 BAcc 点，而 FakeR 在所有五种配置中减少 2.3-5.3 点。这种有限的变化并不能建立基于内容的稳健性。官方时间戳 Skyra 配置保留了第 5 节中确定的先前内容The fine-tuned MLLMs change by at most 2.4 BAcc points relative to their source-matched references, while FakeR decreases by 2.3–5.3 points across all five configurations. This limited variation does not establish content-based robustness. The official-timestamp Skyra configurations retain the prior identified in Section4.1.3;用帧索引替换时间戳将两个检查点减少到 53.7% BAcc。 BusterX++ 达到 49.4% BAcc，其中 FakeR 为 3.9%，RealR 为 94.9%，表明预测倾向很强; replacing timestamps with frame indices reduces both checkpoints to 53.7% BAcc. BusterX+​+ reaches 49.4% BAcc, with 3.9% FakeR and 94.9% RealR, indicating a strong tendency to predict真实Real。这两种行为都无法可靠地检测人类欺骗性视频。. Neither behavior provides reliable detection of human-deceptive videos.

RA-Bench-HumanProof 揭示了探测器系列中不同的故障模式：Gemini 丢失了大部分虚假证据，传统探测器在人类选择之前和之后仍然很弱，而更强的官方 Skyra 结果保留了之前的时间戳。因此，人为故障和探测器故障是重叠的，但它们并不等同。总之，这些结果表明，误导审阅者的视频对于当前的检测器来说也很困难。这种重叠对于生成的描述危机事件的视频尤其重要，这些视频对审查者来说反复显得真实，但从评估的探测器系列中收到的证据薄弱或不可靠。RA-Bench-HumanProof exposes different failure patterns across detector families: Gemini loses much of its fake-side evidence, traditional detectors remain weak before and after human selection, and the stronger official Skyra results retain the timestamp prior. Human and detector failures therefore overlap, but they are not equivalent. Together, these results show that videos that mislead reviewers are also difficult for current detectors. This overlap is particularly consequential for generated videos depicting crisis events, which repeatedly appear real to reviewers while receiving weak or unreliable fake evidence from the evaluated detector families.

外卖。Takeaway.

RA-Bench-HumanProof 在各个检测器系列中仍然很困难：Gemini Binary 和 Diagnostic 达到 54.7% 和 54.5% BAcc，七个传统检测器平均 47.5% AUC，两个无时间戳的 Skyra 检查点达到 53.7% BAcc，而 BusterX++ 仅达到 3.9% FakeR。RA-Bench-HumanProof remains difficult across detector families: Gemini Binary and Diagnostic reach 54.7% and 54.5% BAcc, the seven traditional detectors average 47.5% AUC, both timestamp-free Skyra checkpoints reach 53.7% BAcc, and BusterX+​+ reaches only 3.9% FakeR.

4.3.3 社会传播模拟进一步削弱检测Social Dissemination Simulation Further Weakens Detection

视频很少以标准化形式到达观众或审核系统。因此我们介绍Videos rarely reach viewers or moderation systems in their standardized form. We therefore introduceRA-长凳-最后一英里RA-Bench-LastMile，用于评估探测器可靠性的受控社会传播模拟。它包含 RA-Bench 中 44 个 L2 类别中的 41 个类别的 150 个真实事件主播，以及来自所有九个生成源的匹配视频。原版保留标准化剪辑； T1 应用通用的 VP9 到 H.264 转码； T1+T2、T1+T3 和 T1+T4 在 T1 的基础上添加空间下采样、帧速率降低或合成新闻徽章； Full 结合了所有四种操作。每个条件都相同地应用于每个生成的视频及其匹配的真实锚点。附录, a controlled social dissemination simulation for evaluating detector reliability. It contains 150 real-event anchors spanning 41 of the 44 L2 categories in RA-Bench, together with their matched videos from all nine generation sources. Original retains the standardized clips; T1 applies a common VP9-to-H.264 transcode; T1+T2, T1+T3, and T1+T4 add spatial downsampling, frame-rate reduction, or a synthetic news badge to T1; and Full combines all four operations. Every condition is applied identically to each generated video and its matched real anchor. AppendixD.3提供完整的协议和检测器级结果。provides the complete protocol and detector-level results.

5 讨论Discussion

探测器的可靠性是有条件的。Detector reliability is conditional.

RA-Bench 表明探测器的可靠性不能用单一的基准分数来概括。传统探测器的公共参考性能急剧下降，并且不同发电源的等级发生变化，因此一台发电机的性能无法转移到另一台发电机。零样本多模态模型随提示格式和生成源的不同而变化，而针对 AI 生成的视频检测进行微调的 MLLM 依赖于时间标签格式或强烈支持RA-Bench shows that detector reliability cannot be summarized by a single benchmark score. Traditional detectors fall sharply from their public-reference performance and change rank across generation sources, so performance on one generator does not establish transfer to another. Zero-shot multimodal models vary with prompt format and generation source, while MLLMs fine-tuned for AI-generated video detection depend on temporal-label format or strongly favor the真实Real类。因此，没有经过评估的探测器系列能够提供跨源和评估协议可靠传输的决策规则。随着发生器的发展，调谐到固定源或协议的探测器可能会失去可靠性。因此，评估应将源泛化、提示敏感性、协议依赖性和类别偏差分开。这些结果还激励系统通过模块化或基于代理的工作流程将来自多个探测器和取证工具的证据结合起来，而不是依赖于单个分类器。class. No evaluated detector family therefore provides a decision rule that transfers reliably across sources and evaluation protocols. As generators evolve, detectors tuned to fixed sources or protocols may lose reliability. Evaluation should therefore separate source generalization, prompt sensitivity, protocol dependence, and class bias. These results also motivate systems that combine evidence from multiple detectors and forensic tools through modular or agent-based workflows rather than relying on a single classifier.

生成特性对探测器系列的影响不同。Generation properties affect detector families differently.

在每个生成源中，较强的条件保真度和时间一致性与较弱的虚假证据相关，但最相关的维度在不同探测器系列中有所不同。 Gemini 对条件保真度最敏感，并向动态剪辑分配更多虚假证据，而传统检测器平均值随着 VBench-I2V 质量得分、主体一致性和成像质量的变化更大。在 T2V、第一帧 I2V 和第一帧+最后帧 I2V 中，针对 AI 生成的视频检测进行微调的评估 MLLM 的平均 FakeR 从 70.5% 下降到 42.7% 和 28.3%，而传统检测器 AUC 则在两个方向上移动。因此，检测难度不能通过单个质量分数或生成条件的常见排序来概括。三个采样种子之间的微小变化进一步表明这些模式并不特定于一个采样实现。Within each generation source, stronger Condition Fidelity and temporal consistency are associated with weaker fake evidence, but the most relevant dimensions differ across detector families. Gemini is most sensitive to Condition Fidelity and assigns more fake evidence to dynamic clips, whereas the traditional-detector mean changes more with the VBench-I2V Quality Score, Subject Consistency, and Imaging Quality. Across T2V, first-frame I2V, and first+last-frame I2V, the mean FakeR of the evaluated MLLMs fine-tuned for AI-generated video detection falls from 70.5% to 42.7% and 28.3%, while traditional-detector AUCs move in both directions. Detection difficulty therefore cannot be summarized by a single quality score or a common ordering of generation conditions. The small variation across three sampling seeds further indicates that these patterns are not specific to one sampled realization.

人类欺骗识别出具有社会后果的失败。Human deception identifies socially consequential failures.

人工审查揭示了仅检测器分数无法捕获的故障模式。评论者将 22.8% 的真实视频判断标记为Human review reveals a failure mode that detector scores alone cannot capture. Reviewers label 22.8% of real-video judgments as生成Generated，同时 633 个生成的视频被标记为, while 633 generated videos are labeled真实Real由所有五位指定审稿人进行。这 633 个视频构成by all five assigned reviewers. These 633 videos formRA-工作台-HumanProofRA-Bench-HumanProof，Gemini 在所有三种提示格式下都几乎有机会执行。传统探测器仅表现出较小的额外下降，但其源匹配 RA-Bench 性能已经接近随机。因此，RA-Bench-HumanProof 隔离了生成的视频，这些视频反复误导观众，并且在探测器系列中仍然很困难。当这些视频描述危机事件时，它们可能会作为真实证据流传，并在核实之前扭曲公众的理解。, on which Gemini performs near chance under all three prompt formats. Traditional detectors show only a small additional decline, but their source-matched RA-Bench performance is already close to random. RA-Bench-HumanProof therefore isolates generated videos that repeatedly mislead viewers and remain difficult across detector families. When these videos depict crisis events, they may circulate as authentic evidence and distort public understanding before verification.

社会传播将探测器的预测转向Social dissemination shifts detector predictions toward真实Real.

RA-长凳-最后一英里RA-Bench-LastMile使用社交传播模拟来测量探测器行为如何变化而不改变潜在的事件内容。在 Full 下，七种传统检测器的平均 AUC 从 51.4% 下降到 47.3%，并且排名变化很大。针对 AI 生成的视频检测进行微调的评估 MLLM 在生成的视频上显示出更严重的失败：随着预测转向，它们的平均 FakeR 从 46.0% 下降到 1.4%uses a social dissemination simulation to measure how detector behavior changes without altering the underlying event content. Under Full, the mean AUC of the seven traditional detectors falls from 51.4% to 47.3%, and their ranking changes substantially. The evaluated MLLMs fine-tuned for AI-generated video detection show a sharper failure on generated videos: their mean FakeR falls from 46.0% to 1.4% as predictions shift toward真实Real。下采样、降低帧速率和新闻风格徽章都促成了这种转变。因此，生成的描述危机事件的视频可能会通过自动筛选并在没有真实性警告的情况下到达观众手中，这可能会让错误信息在验证之前有更多时间传播。. Downsampling, frame-rate reduction, and a news-style badge each contribute to this shift. Generated videos depicting crisis events may therefore pass automated screening and reach viewers without an authenticity warning, which may give misinformation more time to spread before verification.

局限性。Limitations.

RA-Bench 提供了对现实世界危机环境中人工智能生成的视频检测的受控评估，而不是对此类内容如何被滥用的完整说明。首先，当前版本必然是快速变化领域的快照。它涵盖了九个 I2V 生成源和纯视觉检测，但新的生成器和检测器可能会很快改变基准测试的难度。因此，RA-Bench 应通过版本更新进行维护，添加新一代源、检测方法和社交传播设置。其次，该基准将 I2V 生成和社会传播作为独立的受控阶段进行研究，后者通过社会传播模拟来表示。在实践中，恶意行为者可能会使用多阶段伪造管道，将生成与选择性编辑、音频合成、上下文字幕和重复平台处理相结合。未来的版本应该评估这些端到端工作流程，同时保留每个阶段的可追踪控制。最后，人类的判断是在受控界面中收集的，周围的社会背景不会影响在线可信度。RA-Bench provides a controlled evaluation of AI-generated video detection in real-world crisis settings rather than a complete account of how such content may be misused. First, the current release is necessarily a snapshot of a rapidly changing field. It covers nine I2V generation sources and visual-only detection, but new generators and detectors may quickly change the difficulty of the benchmark. RA-Bench should therefore be maintained through versioned updates that add new generation sources, detection methods, and social dissemination settings. Second, the benchmark studies I2V generation and social dissemination as separate, controlled stages, with the latter represented through a social dissemination simulation. In practice, malicious actors may use multi-stage forgery pipelines that combine generation with selective editing, audio synthesis, contextual captions, and repeated platform processing. Future versions should evaluate these end-to-end workflows while retaining traceable controls over each stage. Finally, human judgments are collected in a controlled interface without the surrounding social context that can influence credibility online.

6 未来的方向Future Directions

根据我们提出的基准和综合分析，我们提出了几个有希望的方向来激发未来的研究：Based on our proposed benchmark and comprehensive analysis, we present several promising directions to inspire future research:

  • •

    为日益逼真的人工智能生成视频开发强大的检测器。Developing robust detectors for increasingly realistic AI-generated videos.尽管人工智能生成的视频检测已经取得了重大进展，但我们的分析表明，当现有的检测方法应用于最先进的生成器生成的真实视频时，存在巨大的性能差距Although significant progress has been achieved in AI-generated video detection, our analysis demonstrates a substantial performance gap when existing detection methods are applied to realistic videos produced by state-of-the-art generators(van den Oord and Roman 2024; Team Seedance et al. 2026)。应该设计更先进的探测器 利用多种线索，例如时间一致性、照明变化和对象运动，以确保在不同的视频场景和后处理操作中具有稳健的性能。. More advanced detectors should be designed to leverage multiple cues, such as temporal consistency, lighting variations, and object motion, to ensure robust performance across diverse video scenarios and post-processing operations.

  • •

    建立检测器可解释性的评估基准和方法。Establishing evaluation benchmarks and approaches for detector interpretability.基于 MLLM 的检测方法可以提供超出传统方法产生的简单逻辑的详细证据，但这种推理的可靠性在很大程度上尚未得到验证。未来一个有希望的方向是构建全面评估生成证据的正确性和忠实性的基准。在此基础上，未来的工作可以探索基于 MLLM 的代理MLLM-based detection methods can provide detailed evidence beyond the simple logits produced by traditional approaches, yet the reliability of such reasoning remains largely unverified. A promising future direction is to construct benchmarks that comprehensively evaluate the correctness and faithfulness of generated evidence. Building upon this, future work could explore MLLM-based agents(Yao et al. 2025; Xie et al. 2024)和培训后的方法and post-training approaches(Guo et al. 2025; Agarwal et al. 2024)将人工智能生成的视频检测分解为结构化推理步骤，从而进一步提高透明度。to decompose AI-generated video detection into structured reasoning steps, thereby further enhancing transparency.

  • •

    结合主动水印以实现可靠的 AI 生成视频检测。Incorporating active watermarking for reliable AI-generated video detection.为了提高人工智能生成视频检测的可靠性，视频生成模型中的主动水印技术To improve the reliability of AI-generated video detection, active watermarking techniques in video generation models(Fernandez et al. 2024; Hu et al. 2025; Su et al. 2025)代表了另一个重要的研究方向。此类方法可以在生成过程中嵌入可识别信号，使人工智能生成的视频更容易检测。我们的基准可以进一步扩展，以系统地评估主动水印方法在社会传播过程中针对后处理操作的稳健性。此外，未来的工作不应仅仅依赖无源探测器，而应探索它们与主动水印的协同设计，以跟上日益逼真的人工智能生成视频的步伐。represent another important research direction. Such methods can embed identifiable signals during generation, making AI-generated videos easier to detect. Our benchmark can be further extended to systematically evaluate the robustness of active watermarking methods against post-processing operations during social dissemination. Additionally, future work should move beyond solely relying on passive detectors and explore their co-design with active watermarking to keep pace with increasingly realistic AI-generated videos.

  • •

    将人工智能生成的视频检测扩展到视听设置。Extending AI-generated video detection to audio-visual settings.由于现有方法主要依靠视觉证据来检测人工智能生成的视频，因此我们的基准测试侧重于衡量这种视觉检测能力。然而，随着 Seedance 2.0 等视频生成模型Since existing methods mainly rely on visual evidence to detect AI-generated videos, our benchmark focuses on measuring this visual detection ability. However, as video generation models such as Seedance 2.0(Team Seedance et al. 2026)已经开始原生生成音频-视频对齐的内容而不仅仅是无声视频帧，人工智能生成的视频检测也应该超越单纯的视觉提示。未来的工作可以共同探索音频和视觉证据，以实现更可靠、更全面的人工智能生成视频检测，并构建相应的基准来评估这种多模态能力。have started to natively generate audio-video aligned content rather than only silent video frames, AI-generated video detection should also move beyond visual cues alone. Future work could jointly explore audio and visual evidence for more reliable and comprehensive AI-generated video detection, and construct corresponding benchmarks to evaluate such multimodal capabilities.

  • •

    增强视频生成模型的真实感。Enhancing the realism of video generation models.尽管我们的基准测试最初是为了检测人工智能生成的视频而设计的，但它也可以用于相反的方向，以促进更真实的视频生成。我们的分析表明，较高质量的人工智能生成的视频通常更难被人类和检测器识别，这表明检测结果可以作为衡量生成真实性的有用信号。因此，性能最好的现有检测器以及在此基准下开发的未来检测器可以在训练后过程中用作稳健的奖励模型Although our benchmark is originally designed for detecting AI-generated videos, it can also be leveraged in the opposite direction to promote more realistic video generation. Our analysis reveals that higher-quality AI-generated videos are generally harder for both humans and detectors to identify, suggesting that detection results can serve as a useful signal for measuring generation realism. Therefore, the best-performing existing detectors, as well as future detectors developed under this benchmark, can be used as robust reward models during the post-training process(Xu et al. 2026; Liu et al. 2025)视频生成模型。of video generation models.

7 结论Conclusion

我们介绍We introduceRA 工作台RA-Bench，人工智能生成视频检测的基准，使用, a benchmark for AI-generated video detection that usesR真实视频为eal videos asA锚点。 RA-Bench 包含 17,886 个视频，其中包括 10 个社会风险类别的 1,830 个真实视频主播，以及来自四个开源和五个闭源生成器的 16,056 个生成的剪辑。我们评估探测器的泛化、生成特性以及人类感知和社会传播。三个检测器系列都没有在不同的生成源中得到一致的概括：传统检测器的性能与公共参考结果相比急剧下降，零样本多模态模型仍然对提示和源敏感，并且微调的 MLLM 依赖于时间戳线索或表现出强烈的类别偏差。生成特性也对探测器系列产生不同的影响。条件保真度、时间一致性、动态内容和真实图像条件显示出与传统检测器和 MLLM 输出的不同关系，而源级检测模式在三个采样种子中保持稳定。人工审核确定了 633 个生成的视频进行了评判nchors. RA-Bench contains 17,886 videos, comprising 1,830 real-video anchors across 10 social-risk categories and 16,056 generated clips from four open-source and five closed-source generators. We evaluate detector generalization, generation properties, and human perception and social dissemination. None of the three detector families generalizes consistently across generation sources: traditional-detector performance falls sharply from public-reference results, zero-shot multimodal models remain sensitive to prompts and sources, and fine-tuned MLLMs depend on timestamp cues or exhibit strong class bias. Generation properties also affect detector families differently. Condition Fidelity, temporal consistency, dynamic content, and real-image conditioning show different relationships with traditional-detector and MLLM outputs, while source-level detection patterns remain stable across three sampling seeds. Human review identifies 633 generated videos judged真实Real由所有五位指定的审稿人组成by all five assigned reviewers, formingRA-工作台-HumanProofRA-Bench-HumanProof，Gemini 在所有三种提示格式下都几乎有机会执行。, on which Gemini performs near chance under all three prompt formats.RA-长凳-最后一英里RA-Bench-LastMile进一步表明，社交传播模拟将针对 AI 生成视频检测进行微调的评估 MLLM 的平均 FakeR 从 46.0% 降低到 1.4%。总之，这些结果表明，当前的方法仍然无法在现实世界的危机环境中可靠地检测真实的人工智能生成的视频。further shows that the social dissemination simulation reduces mean FakeR across the evaluated MLLMs fine-tuned for AI-generated video detection from 46.0% to 1.4%. Together, these results show that current methods still cannot reliably detect realistic AI-generated videos in real-world crisis settings.

A.5 后处理细节Postprocessing Details

本小节报告了确切的计数更改操作、编码设置、 和节中使用的源级权限审查This subsection reports the exact count-changing operations, encoding settings, and source-level rights review used in Section3.4.

持续时间限制。Duration bounding.

每个剪辑都限制在 3–15 秒的窗口内：剪辑 短于 3 秒的剪辑将被丢弃，而长于 15 秒的剪辑将被截断。这个 步骤删除 1 个剪辑并截断 444 个，留下 2,425 个长度有限的剪辑。Each clip is bounded to a 3–15 s window: clips shorter than 3 s are discarded, while clips longer than 15 s are truncated. This step removes one clip and truncates 444, leaving 2,425 length-bounded clips.

编码标准化。Encoding standardization.

我们对每个视频流进行重新编码 使用 H.264 保留剪辑We re-encode the video stream of every retained clip with H.264 using库x264libx264, 预设, preset慢slow, 和 CRF, and CRF1717。稍后将相同的发布编码应用于生成的剪辑，以便编解码器 选择和编码器配置不充当标签提示。. The same release encoding is later applied to generated clips so that codec choice and encoder configuration do not serve as label cues.

同质修剪。Homogeneity pruning.

我们应用互斥的每个源 计划减少过多的上传，而不施加相同的类别配额。 最多保留 10 个剪辑的源保持不变。对于 11-20 的来源， 21–30、31–40 和 41–50 个剪辑，我们每 5、4、3 和 2 中删除一个剪辑， 分别；对于包含超过 50 个剪辑的源，我们会删除大约 70% 随机的。密度修剪去除We apply the mutually exclusive per-source schedule to reduce overrepresented uploads without imposing equal category quotas. Sources with at most 10 retained clips are unchanged. For sources with 11–20, 21–30, 31–40, and 41–50 clips, we remove one clip in every 5, 4, 3, and 2, respectively; for sources with more than 50 clips, we remove approximately 70% at random. Density pruning removes519519剪辑。删除另外七组 手动识别的重复剪辑会丢弃另一个clips. Removing seven additional groups of manually identified repetitive clips discards another7676, 对于, for595595搬迁 总共。removals in total.

维权审查。Rights review.

权利根据来源确定，只有一个决定 覆盖该来源的所有剪辑。七位审稿人中的两位负责处理手册 的队列Rights are determined per source, with one decision covering all clips from that source. 然后对每个源进行映射Each source then mapstgent_{\text{gen}}到其支持的时间网格。万2.2 和 OmniWeaving 源使用to its supported temporal grid. The Wan2.2 and OmniWeaving sources use a4​n+14n{+}1网格速度为 16 fps，而 LTX 使用grid at 16 fps, whereas LTX uses an8​n+18n{+}1网格速度为 24 fps；这两项政策都规定了 33 帧的下限。分开的 Wan2.2固定持续时间控制使用81帧（5.06 s）并且被排除在 基准计数。 Seedance 接受从 4 到 15 s 的整数持续时间，因此 在我们的目标政策下实现4-8%。grid at 24 fps; both policies impose a floor of 33 frames. The separate Wan2.2 fixed-duration control uses 81 frames (5.06 s) and is excluded from the benchmark count. Seedance accepts integer durations from 4 to 15 s and therefore realizes 4–8 s under our target policy.

Hailuo 768P I2V端点仅公开6秒和10秒的输出。The Hailuo 768P I2V endpoint exposes only 6- and 10-second outputs.33 3最小最大 图像转视频 API 文档：MiniMax Image-to-Video API documentation:https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/video-generation-i2v.因此，我们使用 7.5 s 作为边界：等于或高于 7.5 s 的目标持续时间为 生成为 10 秒的剪辑，而较短的目标生成为 6 秒 剪辑。这种特定于提供商的离散化解释了为什么海洛不遵循 为共享策略报告连续 2-8 个目标范围。We therefore use 7.5 s as the boundary: target durations at or above 7.5 s are generated as 10-second clips, whereas shorter targets are generated as 6-second clips. This provider-specific discretization explains why Hailuo does not follow the continuous 2–8 s target range reported for the shared policy.

B.1 探测器评估协议和模型输入Detector Evaluation Protocol and Model Inputs

对于每个生成源，我们评估每个生成的视频及其 匹配真正的锚。每个开源生成器贡献 1,830 个这样的对； 对于每个闭源生成器，评估仅限于锚点 提供商返回生成的视频。基准水平结果给出 与九个 RA-Bench 生成源的权重相同。固定期限的Wan2.2 无论在何处报告并排除控制，该控制均标有星号 这些平均值。For each generation source, we evaluate every generated video together with its matched real anchor. Each open-source generator contributes 1,830 such pairs; for each closed-source generator, evaluation is restricted to the anchors for which the provider returned a generated video. Benchmark-level results give equal weight to the nine RA-Bench generation sources. The fixed-duration Wan2.2 control is marked with an asterisk wherever it is reported and is excluded from these averages.

除非消融另有说明，否则我们保留每个方法的已发布版本 检查点或 API 版本、视觉预处理、时间采样策略以及 分数提取规则。连续评分方法通过配对 AUC 进行评估 和 TPR 为 5% FPR (T@5%)；离散输出通过 BAcc、宏 F1、 和FakeR。对于连续输出，释放的分数方向是固定的 所有来源；当 AUC 低于 50% 时，分数不会事后反转。我们 不要应用源特定的反转，因为它需要知道 生成者身份并且不会测量跨源传输。我们另外 在分析类别偏好时报告真实回忆 (RealR)。 零样本多模态模型仅接收采样的视频帧；不 文件名、生成器身份、种子、数据集标签或其他辅助元数据 提供。表Unless an ablation states otherwise, we preserve each method’s released checkpoint or API version, visual preprocessing, temporal sampling policy, and score-extraction rule. Continuous-score methods are evaluated with paired AUC and TPR at 5% FPR (T@5%); discrete outputs are evaluated with BAcc, macro-F1, and FakeR. For continuous outputs, the released score direction is fixed across all sources; scores are not inverted post hoc when AUC falls below 50%. We do not apply source-specific inversion because it would require knowing the generator identity and would not measure cross-source transfer. We additionally report real recall (RealR) when analyzing class preference. Zero-shot multimodal models receive sampled video frames only; no filename, generator identity, seed, dataset label, or other auxiliary metadata is provided. These API evaluations were conducted in June–July 2026. Because the providers expose model aliases rather than immutable public snapshots, we report the exact invoked identifiers and access period rather than infer unrecorded version numbers.

这些方法没有观察到相同的时间证据。框架级模型 对剪辑中的孤立帧进行采样，DeCoF 强调开放帧， D3 和 ReStraV 评估局部窗口，多模态模型获得更广泛的支持 多帧摘要。这些差异是已发布的推论的一部分 协议，因此主要比较将每个检测器视为端到端系统。The methods do not observe identical temporal evidence. Frame-level models sample isolated frames across the clip, DeCoF emphasizes the opening frames, D3 and ReStraV evaluate local windows, and the multimodal models receive broader multi-frame summaries. These differences are part of the released inference protocols, so the main comparison treats each detector as an end-to-end system.

时间采样控制。Temporal-sampling control.

第节中的对照实验The controlled experiment in Section4.1.1仅改变 固定八帧输入的时间分配。 Uniform-8 选择八帧 在均匀间隔的位置。对于 Global–Local-8，首先扫描每个剪辑 4 fps，短边 160 像素。我们构建了一个相机补偿事件 残余运动、结构变化及其时间变化的曲线， 然后选择以最强响应为中心的四个连续帧和四个 均匀间隔的帧。粗略扫描仅用于路由，不用于 传递至检测器；探测器 权重、检测器端预处理和分数聚合保持不变。 实验涵盖八个固定长度的 RA-Bench 源和辅助源 固定持续时间的 Wan2.2 控制，产生九个评估设置； 动态持续时间 Wan2.2 是 排除。我们报告这些设置的宏观平均 AUC 并估计 具有源块引导的五检测器平均置信区间。这个 消融平均值与定义的基准级 RA-Bench 平均值分开 上面。changes only the temporal allocation of a fixed eight-frame input. Uniform-8 selects eight frames at uniformly spaced positions. For Global–Local-8, each clip is first scanned at 4 fps with a 160-pixel short side. We construct a camera-compensated eventness curve from residual motion, structural change, and their temporal variation, then select four consecutive frames centered on the strongest response and four uniformly spaced frames. The coarse scan is used only for routing and is not passed to the detector; detector weights, detector-side preprocessing, and score aggregation remain unchanged. The experiment covers eight fixed-length RA-Bench sources and the auxiliary fixed-duration Wan2.2 control, yielding nine evaluated settings; dynamic-duration Wan2.2 is excluded. We report macro-average AUC over these settings and estimate the five-detector mean confidence interval with a source-block bootstrap. This ablation average is separate from the benchmark-level RA-Bench averages defined above.

B.2 传统探测器参考传输和操作点Traditional-Detector Reference Transfer and Operating Points

B.3 零样本多模态模型协议和扩展分析Zero-Shot Multimodal Model Protocol and Extended Analysis

统一的评估协议。Unified evaluation protocol.

所有零样本多模态模型都接收相同的 16 个时间顺序帧 短边分辨率为 256 像素。没有文件名、来源、种子、数据集、 提供水印或其他元数据。我们评估三种提示格式： 二进制请求明确的结论，诊断请求五个方面的分数 和判决，评级要求连续的人工智能生成分数和 判决。视觉证据和真实与生成的决策任务仍然存在 修复了三种格式的问题。All zero-shot multimodal models receive the same 16 temporally ordered frames at a short-side resolution of 256 pixels. No filename, source, seed, dataset, watermark, or other metadata is provided. We evaluate three prompt formats: Binary requests a categorical verdict, Diagnostic requests five aspect scores and a verdict, and Rating requests a continuous AI-generation score and a verdict. The visual evidence and real-versus-generated decision task remain fixed across the three formats.

所有汇总结果都对发电来源给予同等重视，而不是 单独的剪辑。 Open 涵盖四个开源 RA-Bench 生成器，Closed 涵盖五个闭源发电机，All 涵盖所有九个来源。的 固定持续时间 Wan2.2 设置是辅助时间控制，被排除在外 从这些平均值中。All aggregate results give equal weight to generation sources rather than individual clips. Open covers the four open-source RA-Bench generators, Closed covers the five closed-source generators, and All covers all nine sources. The fixed-duration Wan2.2 setting is an auxiliary temporal control and is excluded from these averages.

The shared prefix fixes the visual input, prohibits metadata, and asks the model to judge the clip as a whole. Rating and Diagnostic scores measure the apparent degree of AI generation rather than confidence.

与提示相关的操作点。Prompt-dependent operating points.

图Figure15显示了为什么仅 BAcc 不足以比较三个提示。 Qwen3.5-0.8B 从有利于真实的二元规则更改为在诊断和评级下预测几乎每个视频都是假的。 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 朝相反的方向发展：二进制有利于假，而结构化提示有利于真实。这些模型都可以保持在 50% BAcc 附近，因为一类的错误会抵消另一类的正确决策，尽管代表了不同质量的操作点。shows why BAcc alone is insufficient for comparing the three prompts. Qwen3.5-0.8B changes from a Real-favoring Binary rule to predicting nearly every video as fake under Diagnostic and Rating. Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B move in the opposite direction: Binary favors fake, whereas the structured prompts favor real. These models can all remain near 50% BAcc because errors on one class offset correct decisions on the other, despite representing qualitatively different operating points.

Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 在提示格式上变化不大：FakeR 保持在 51.8% 到 54.4% 之间，而 RealR 保持在 72.4% 到 75.1% 之间。 Qwen3.7-Plus 也很稳定，但仍然偏向真实。 GPT-5.5 说明了为什么仅提示稳定性是不够的：其 FakeR 在每次提示下都保持在 4.5% 以下，而 RealR 则超过 99%。因此，报告 FakeR 和 RealR 对于区分提示不变检测行为和持久类偏好是必要的。Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview changes little across prompt formats: its FakeR remains between 51.8% and 54.4%, while RealR remains between 72.4% and 75.1%. Qwen3.7-Plus is also stable but remains tilted toward real. GPT-5.5 shows why prompt stability alone is insufficient: its FakeR remains below 4.5% under every prompt while RealR exceeds 99%. Reporting FakeR and RealR is therefore necessary to distinguish prompt-invariant detection behavior from a persistent class preference.

绝对评级分数在模型之间不能直接比较。Absolute Rating scores are not directly comparable across models.

图Figure16表明模型使用 0-100 等级的方式非常不同。 Qwen3.5-2B 为生成的视频分配了 81.7 分，为真实视频分配了 77.5 分，而 Qwen3.5-9B 分配了 1.6 和 1.1。两者都接近机会 AUC。因此，高绝对评级并不意味着更强的分离，并且不同模型的分数不应作为生成概率进行比较。shows that models use the 0–100 scale very differently. Qwen3.5-2B assigns mean scores of 81.7 to generated videos and 77.5 to real videos, whereas Qwen3.5-9B assigns 1.6 and 1.1. Both remain close to chance AUC. A high absolute rating therefore does not imply stronger separation, and scores from different models should not be compared as generation probabilities.

连续排名和分类决策在一个模型中也可能出现分歧。尽管 GPT-5.5 为这两个类别分配了低分，但它获得了 62.1% 的配对 AUC，但其明确的判决仅产生 36.9% 的宏 F1，因为它预测几乎每个视频都是真实的。 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 是唯一一个配对 AUC 和判决宏 F1 均高于 60% 的评估模型。因此，我们报告连续得分的配对 AUC 并单独评估明确的判决，而不是使用事后阈值得出额外的预测。Continuous ranking and categorical decisions can also diverge within one model. GPT-5.5 obtains 62.1% paired AUC despite assigning low scores to both classes, but its explicit verdict yields only 36.9% macro-F1 because it predicts almost every video as real. Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview is the only evaluated model with both paired AUC and verdict macro-F1 above 60%. We therefore report paired AUC for the continuous score and evaluate the explicit verdict separately rather than deriving an additional prediction with a post hoc threshold.

诊断提示通常会缩减为一个全局分数。The Diagnostic prompt often collapses to one global score.

图Figure17将每个诊断维度作为连续信号进行评估。对于 Qwen3.5-0.8B、4B、9B 和 27B，方面 AUC 仍然接近机会，而精确五崩溃超过 94%。这些模型通常在所有要求的维度上重复一个全局分数，而不是提供特定方面的判断。evaluates each Diagnostic dimension as a continuous signal. For Qwen3.5-0.8B, 4B, 9B, and 27B, aspect AUC remains near chance while exact-five collapse exceeds 94%. These models usually repeat one global score across all requested dimensions rather than provide aspect-specific judgments.

Qwen3.7-Plus 在 AUC 方面达到 55.6-57.5%，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 达到 54.5-54.8%，但两者仍然崩溃了大部分完整输出。 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 在 AUC 方面达到了 62.6–63.8%，但在 55.2% 的完整输出中为所有五个维度分配了相同的值。 GPT-5.5很少折叠这五个值，但其Temporal和Motion得分仅达到44.9%和48.6% AUC。因此，有用的诊断需要不同的输出和特定维度的分离。Qwen3.7-Plus reaches 55.6–57.5% aspect AUC, and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B reaches 54.5–54.8%, but both still collapse a majority of complete outputs. Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview reaches 62.6–63.8% aspect AUC, yet assigns the same value to all five dimensions in 55.2% of complete outputs. GPT-5.5 rarely collapses the five values, but its Temporal and Motion scores reach only 44.9% and 48.6% AUC. A useful diagnostic therefore requires both distinct outputs and dimension-specific separation.

这些分析区分了聚合 BAcc 无法区分的三种行为。 FakeR 和 RealR 揭示了提示引发的类别偏好，评级 AUC 衡量连续排名，诊断 AUC 以及崩溃测试结构化响应是否包含特定方面的信息。因此，我们在表中报告了类别条件和结构化输出分析These analyses separate three behaviors that aggregate BAcc cannot distinguish. FakeR and RealR reveal prompt-induced class preference, Rating AUC measures continuous ranking, and Diagnostic AUC together with collapse tests whether structured responses contain aspect-specific information. We therefore report the class-conditional and structured-output analyses alongside Table3而不是将一个汇总分数视为零样本检测能力的充分证据。rather than treating one summary score as sufficient evidence of zero-shot detection ability.

B.4 微调 MLLM 协议灵敏度和类条件行为Fine-Tuned MLLM Protocol Sensitivity and Class-Conditional Behavior

我们在两种时间标签设置下评估 Skyra。官方提示为 16 个采样帧中的每一个都加上了绝对时间戳作为前缀。帧索引提示将这些前缀替换为We evaluate Skyra under two temporal-label settings. The official prompt prefixes each of the 16 sampled frames with its absolute timestamp. The frame-index prompt replaces these prefixes with[帧=01][Frame=01]通过through[帧=16][Frame=16]，同时保留图像及其顺序。两种设置均涵盖九个 RA-Bench 生成源和辅助 Wan2.2 固定持续时间控制。由于视觉输入未改变，因此比较测量对时间标签表示的敏感性。, while preserving the images and their order. Both settings cover the nine RA-Bench generation sources and the auxiliary Wan2.2 fixed-duration control. Because the visual input is unchanged, the comparison measures sensitivity to the temporal-label representation.

表Table19表明用帧索引替换时间戳会改变类别偏好，而不是减少两个类别的召回率。 Skyra-SFT 在源代码相同的 FakeR 中获得 4.0 分，但在全套 RealR 中损失 32.0 分； Skyra-RL 在 FakeR 中获得 5.5 分，但在全套 RealR 中损失 34.5 分。因此，两个 BAcc 值都会下降至 55% 左右。shows that replacing timestamps with frame indices changes the class preference rather than reducing recall for both classes. Skyra-SFT gains 4.0 points in source-equal FakeR but loses 32.0 points in full-set RealR; Skyra-RL gains 5.5 points in FakeR but loses 34.5 points in full-set RealR. Both BAcc values consequently fall to about 55%.

我们对已发布的 ViF-CoT-4K 和 ViF-Bench 元数据的审核Our audit of the released ViF-CoT-4K and ViF-Bench metadata(Li et al. 2025)找到与标签相关的时间网格。在 ViF-CoT-4K 中，2,017 个真实样本中的 81 个 (4.0%) 和 2,017 个生成样本中的 1,074 个 (53.2%) 的最终时间戳恰好为 5.00 秒。在 ViF-Bench 中，相应的比例是 165 个真实样本中的 97 个（58.8%）和 2,997 个生成样本中的 2,994 个（99.9%）。由于这些时间戳直接在提示中公开，因此最终的时间标签可以充当先验标签。finds a label-correlated temporal grid. In ViF-CoT-4K, the final timestamp is exactly 5.00 seconds for 81 of 2,017 real samples (4.0%) and 1,074 of 2,017 generated samples (53.2%). In ViF-Bench, the corresponding proportions are 97 of 165 real samples (58.8%) and 2,994 of 2,997 generated samples (99.9%). Because these timestamps are exposed directly in the prompt, the final temporal tag can act as a label prior.

表Table20和图and Figure18在 RA-Bench 上显示相应的行为。在官方时间戳提示下，每个符合条件的来源对精确 5 秒剪辑的虚假召回率都高于其他剪辑。 Skyra-SFT 的源相等差距范围为 29.0 到 82.8 点，Skyra-RL 的源相等差距范围为 23.7 到 80.3 点。用帧索引替换时间戳可将平均差距分别从 48.6 点减少到 1.5 点，从 43.4 点减少到 1.4 点。show the corresponding behavior on RA-Bench. Under the official-timestamp prompt, every eligible source has higher fake recall for exact-5-second clips than for other clips. The source-equal gap ranges from 29.0 to 82.8 points for Skyra-SFT and from 23.7 to 80.3 points for Skyra-RL. Replacing timestamps with frame indices reduces the mean gap from 48.6 to 1.5 points and from 43.4 to 1.4 points, respectively.

这两个单层来源提供了互补的证据。 Wan2.2 修复仅包含精确 5 秒的剪辑；帧索引将 Skyra-SFT 的 FakeR 从 96.4% 降低到 62.8%，将 Skyra-RL 的 FakeR 从 97.7% 降低到 68.4%。海洛没有精确的5秒片段，FakeR反而从22.5%上升到56.6%，从28.3%上升到64.6%。这些相反的转变与时间先验一致，该先验倾向于在 5 秒时做出假判决，否则做出真实判决。The two single-stratum sources provide complementary evidence. Wan2.2 fixed contains only exact-5-second clips; frame indices reduce FakeR from 96.4% to 62.8% for Skyra-SFT and from 97.7% to 68.4% for Skyra-RL. Hailuo has no exact-5-second clips, and FakeR instead rises from 22.5% to 56.6% and from 28.3% to 64.6%. These opposite shifts are consistent with a temporal prior that favors a fake verdict at 5 seconds and a real verdict otherwise.

切换到帧索引并不能消除源依赖性。在框架指数下，Skyra-SFT 的源 BAcc 仍然在 31.1% 到 61.0% 之间，Skyra-RL 的范围在 29.7% 到 61.3% 之间。 SFT 和 RL 的源模式在两个时间戳下保持高度一致（SpearmanSwitching to frame indices does not eliminate source dependence. Under frame indices, source-wise BAcc still ranges from 31.1% to 61.0% for Skyra-SFT and from 29.7% to 61.3% for Skyra-RL. The source patterns of SFT and RL remain strongly aligned under both timestamps (Spearmanρ=0.93\rho=0.93）和帧索引（) and frame indices (ρ=0.95\rho=0.95）。特别是，这两种变体在 LTX 上都保留了非常低的帧索引 FakeR。因此，强化学习会改变工作点，但不会消除共享的特定源故障模式。). In particular, both variants retain very low frame-index FakeR on LTX. RL therefore shifts the operating point but does not remove the shared source-specific failure pattern.

BusterX++ 表现出不同的类条件故障。跨九个基准源和 Wan2.2 修复BusterX+​+ exhibits a different class-conditional failure. Across the nine benchmark sources and Wan2.2 fixed∗，其发布的管道仅达到 4.1-9.1% FakeR，而 RealR 保持在 93.0-93.8%。它预测, its released pipeline attains only 4.1–9.1% FakeR while RealR remains at 93.0–93.8%. It predicts真实Real大约 93.6% 的配对输入，很大程度上独立于发电源。这种行为解释了为什么尽管表中 RealR 较高，但其宏 F1 仍然较低for approximately 93.6% of the paired inputs, largely independent of generation source. This behavior explains why its macro-F1 remains low despite high RealR in Table4。因此，Skyra 和 BusterX++ 结果表明了为什么在评估微调 MLLM 时需要平衡和类别条件指标。. The Skyra and BusterX+​+ results therefore show why balanced and class-conditional metrics are necessary when evaluating fine-tuned MLLMs.
