C.1 发电质量和可检测性Generation Quality and Detectability

VBench++ I2V 协议。VBench++ I2V protocol.

我们在所有 16,056 个生成的剪辑上运行已发布的 VBench++ I2V 评估器。评价内容包括主体一致性、背景一致性、运动平滑度、动态度、美观度、成像质量，以及视频图像主体一致性和视频图像背景一致性。官方 VBench-I2V 质量得分将归一化后的前六个维度与发布的范围相结合，对动态度使用权重 0.5，对其余每个维度使用权重 1。我们将条件保真度定义为两个归一化视频图像一致性分数的平均值，将组合质量定义为 VBench-I2V 质量分数和条件保真度的等权平均值。摄像机运动被排除，因为 RA-Bench 提示不提供该评估器所需的受控摄像机运动标签。因此，条件保真度和综合质量是特定于基准测试的聚合，而不是官方的 VBench-I2V I2V 分数和总分。We run the released VBench++ I2V evaluators on all 16,056 generated clips. The evaluation covers Subject Consistency, Background Consistency, Motion Smoothness, Dynamic Degree, Aesthetic Quality, and Imaging Quality, together with Video–Image Subject Consistency and Video–Image Background Consistency. The official VBench-I2V Quality Score combines the first six dimensions after normalization with the released ranges, using weight 0.5 for Dynamic Degree and weight 1 for each remaining dimension. We define Condition Fidelity as the mean of the two normalized Video–Image consistency scores and Combined Quality as the equal-weight mean of the VBench-I2V Quality Score and Condition Fidelity. Camera Motion is excluded because RA-Bench prompts do not provide the controlled camera-motion labels required by that evaluator. Condition Fidelity and Combined Quality are therefore benchmark-specific aggregates rather than the official VBench-I2V I2V Score and Total Score.

所有八个维度的分数均由已发布的评估者根据 RA-Bench 输入生成。由于 RA-Bench 使用真实事件调节图像和提示，而不是 VBench++ 图像套件，因此这些结果代表了当前基准的特征，并不用于与官方排行榜直接比较。源级主题和背景一致性保留已发布的帧级聚合。相反，关联分析对每个剪辑使用一个分数向量，以便视频持续时间不会决定统计权重。所有 16,056 个剪辑的所有八个维度均已完成。All eight dimension scores are produced by the released evaluators on RA-Bench inputs. Because RA-Bench uses real-event conditioning images and prompts rather than the VBench++ Image Suite, these results characterize the present benchmark and are not intended for direct comparison with the official leaderboard. Source-level Subject and Background Consistency retain the released frame-level aggregation. The association analysis instead uses one score vector per clip so that video duration does not determine statistical weight. All eight dimensions are complete for all 16,056 clips.

关联分析。Association analysis.

对于每个连续分数，我们计算每个生成源和动态度组内的百分位数排名。我们为每个源-组组合拟合一个具有固定效应的模型，给予每个源相同的总权重，并报告与四分位数增加相关的估计变化。该规范保留了连续的分数，而不是将剪辑划分为离散的质量组。 Gemini 二进制和诊断输出由虚假指标表示，而评级则缩放为For each continuous score, we compute percentile ranks within every generation source and Dynamic Degree group. We fit a model with fixed effects for each source–group combination, give every source equal total weight, and report the estimated change associated with an interquartile increase. This specification retains the continuous scores rather than dividing clips into discrete quality groups. Gemini Binary and Diagnostic outputs are represented by fake indicators, while Rating is scaled to[0,1][0,1]。传统检测器的假分数在对七个检测器进行平均之前会转换为每个检测器和源内的经验百分位数，从而防止检测器特定的分数范围主导平均值。二进制的有效样本计数为 15,347，诊断的有效样本计数为 15,890，评级的有效样本计数为 15,451，传统检测器平均值的有效样本计数为 16,052。. Traditional-detector fake scores are converted to empirical percentiles within each detector and source before averaging across the seven detectors, preventing detector-specific score scales from dominating the mean. The valid sample counts are 15,347 for Binary, 15,890 for Diagnostic, 15,451 for Rating, and 16,052 for the traditional-detector mean.

动态度在已发布的评估器中是二元的，并通过与生成源和真实锚点固定效应的动态减静态对比进行单独分析。置信区间在真实锚点级别使用集群稳健的标准误差来解释从同一锚点派生的多个生成的剪辑。所有估计值都被解释为 RA-Bench 内调整后的关联，而不是质量对探测器行为的因果影响。Dynamic Degree is binary in the released evaluator and is analyzed separately through a dynamic-minus-static contrast with generation-source and real-anchor fixed effects. Confidence intervals use cluster-robust standard errors at the real-anchor level to account for multiple generated clips derived from the same anchor. All estimates are interpreted as adjusted associations within RA-Bench rather than causal effects of quality on detector behavior.

源代码级别的概要文件是描述性的，而不是主要分析的基础。 VBench-I2V 质量分数范围为 72.9–78.0，条件保真度范围为 91.1–96.4，综合质量分数范围为 83.7–86.7。这些狭窄的范围并不意味着类似的检测难度。例如，LTX 和 Seedance2.0 的综合质量得分均为 83.7，而 Gemini Diagnostic 的虚假召回率分别为 74.5% 和 32.3%。因此，我们依赖于源内剪辑级别关联，而不是源级别质量排名。The source-level profile is descriptive rather than the basis of the main analysis. The VBench-I2V Quality Score spans 72.9–78.0, Condition Fidelity spans 91.1–96.4, and Combined Quality spans 83.7–86.7. These narrow ranges do not imply similar detection difficulty. LTX and Seedance2.0, for example, both obtain a Combined Quality score of 83.7, while their Gemini Diagnostic fake recalls are 74.5% and 32.3%, respectively. We therefore rely on within-source clip-level associations rather than source-level quality rankings.

表Table22显示出三种不同的模式。条件保真度与所有三个 Gemini 输出具有最大的聚合关联，而 VBench-I2V 质量得分与传统检测器平均值具有最大的关联。每个检测器输出的四个受试者和背景一致性测量均为负，而美学质量和成像质量与 Gemini Diagnostic 没有明显关联。双子座的动态度变化方向相反，但传统探测器的平均值几乎为零。因此，单个聚合质量得分将维度与不同的特定于检测器的关联相结合。shows three distinct patterns. Condition Fidelity has the largest aggregate association with all three Gemini outputs, whereas the VBench-I2V Quality Score has the largest association with the traditional-detector mean. The four subject and background consistency measures are negative across every detector output, while Aesthetic Quality and Imaging Quality show no clear association with Gemini Diagnostic. Dynamic Degree changes in the opposite direction for Gemini but is nearly null for the traditional-detector mean. A single aggregate quality score therefore combines dimensions with different detector-specific associations.

分析集。Analysis set.

人类研究来自 17,886 个视频 RA-Bench 池：1,830 个真实主播和来自四个开源生成器和五个闭源提供商的 16,056 个生成剪辑。报告的第一阶段结果使用标准的三审查流，其中包含 17,850 个视频和 53,550 个判断。该分析集包含 1,812 个真实视频和 16,038 个生成视频，每个视频分配给三个不同的审阅者。其余 36 个视频保留用于内部任务级质量控制，不包括在报告的识别统计数据和 RA-Bench-HumanProof 构建中。The human study is drawn from the 17,886-video RA-Bench pool: 1,830 real anchors and 16,056 generated clips from four open-source generators and five closed-source providers. The reported Stage 1 results use the standard three-review stream, which contains 17,850 videos and 53,550 judgments. This analysis set comprises 1,812 real videos and 16,038 generated videos, with each video assigned to three different reviewers. The remaining 36 videos were reserved for internal assignment-level quality control and are excluded from the reported recognition statistics and RA-Bench-HumanProof construction.

审阅者、培训和作业。Reviewers, training, and assignment.

20名第一阶段评审员和另外两名第二阶段评审员是从中国和国外大学招募的本科生和研究生。在注释之前，所有审稿人在审稿界面和标签定义上完成相同的标准化培训。在第一阶段，界面一次展示一个视频以及可选的 16 帧联系表，并要求审阅者进行选择The 20 Stage 1 reviewers and two additional Stage 2 reviewers are undergraduate and graduate students recruited from universities in China and abroad. Before annotation, all reviewers complete the same standardized training on the review interface and label definitions. In Stage 1, the interface presents one video at a time together with an optional 16-frame contact sheet and asks the reviewer to choose真实Real, 不确定Uncertain, 或, or生成Generated。没有显示来源或标签信息。来自不同来源的真实视频和生成视频以审阅者特定的随机顺序交错，并且作业在审阅者之间进行平衡。审阅者可以重播视频并修改他们之前的响应。该界面没有强制规定最短观看时间，但会指示审阅者在提交之前检查每个视频。. No source or label information is shown. Real and generated videos from different sources are interleaved in a reviewer-specific randomized order, and assignments are balanced across reviewers. The interface does not enforce a minimum viewing time, but reviewers are instructed to inspect each video before submitting.

配对评估和源匹配参考。Paired evaluation and source-matched reference.

RA-Bench-HumanProof 中生成的每个视频都保留其真实主播的标识符。因此，检测器评估使用 633 个生成的真实对，对应于 511 个独特的真实视频，因为多个生成的视频可能共享一个锚点。对于离散输出，我们将 BAcc 与 FakeR 和 RealR 一起报告。对于连续分数，我们以 5% 的真实视频假阳性率 (T@5%) 报告配对 AUC 和假视频真阳性率。Every generated video in RA-Bench-HumanProof retains the identifier of its real anchor. Detector evaluation therefore uses 633 generated–real pairs, corresponding to 511 unique real videos because several generated videos may share an anchor. For discrete outputs, we report BAcc together with FakeR and RealR. For continuous scores, we report paired AUC and the fake-video true-positive rate at a 5% real-video false-positive rate (T@5%).

RA-Bench-HumanProof 包含比完整 RA-Bench 更大份额的 Seedance2.0 和 Kling 视频。因此，未加权的比较将把人类选择的影响与来源构成的变化结合起来。对于每个指标，我们将 RA-Bench 参考计算为RA-Bench-HumanProof contains a larger share of Seedance2.0 and Kling videos than full RA-Bench. An unweighted comparison would therefore combine human-selection effects with a change in source composition. It controls the source mixture, but not the conditional selection induced by the five human judgments.

探测器系列结果。Detector-family results.

七个传统检测器的平均 AUC 适度下降了 2.0 个点，从源匹配 RA-Bench 加权下的 49.5% 降至 RA-Bench-HumanProof 上的 47.5%。他们各自的 AUC 跨度仅为 33.1%–59.0%，平均 T@5% 从 4.6% 变化到 4.4%。这些小的或异构的变化并不表明稳健性：源匹配基线已经接近随机排名，并且以 5% 的误报率提供很少的生成视频召回率。The seven traditional detectors show a modest mean AUC decrease of 2.0 points, from 49.5% under source-matched RA-Bench weighting to 47.5% on RA-Bench-HumanProof. Their individual AUCs span only 33.1%–59.0%, and their mean T@5% changes from 4.6% to 4.4%. These small or heterogeneous changes do not indicate robustness: the source-matched baseline is already close to random ranking and provides little generated-video recall at a 5% false-positive rate.

双子座表现出与人类困难最明显的一致性。 Binary 和 Diagnostic BAcc 各下降 6.5 分，而 FakeR 分别下降 15.6 分和 17.3 分。评级 AUC 下降 6.6 点，T@5% 下降 1.3 点。损失集中在生成端：Binary 和 Diagnostic FakeR 分别下降至 34.3% 和 30.0%，而 RealR 仍保持 75.2% 和 79.0%。因此，在 RA-Bench-HumanProof 上，Gemini 提供了明显较弱的虚假证据，而在匹配的真实视频上却没有类似的损失。Gemini shows the clearest alignment with human difficulty. Binary and Diagnostic BAcc each decrease by 6.5 points, while their FakeR decreases by 15.6 and 17.3 points, respectively. Rating AUC decreases by 6.6 points and T@5% by 1.3 points. The loss is concentrated on the generated side: Binary and Diagnostic FakeR fall to 34.3% and 30.0%, while RealR remains 75.2% and 79.0%. On RA-Bench-HumanProof, Gemini therefore provides substantially weaker fake evidence without a comparable loss on the matched real videos.

经过微调的 MLLM 需要不同的解释。在所有五种配置中，他们的 BAcc 最多变化 2.4 点，FakeR 下降 2.3-5.3 点。 Skyra-SFT 和 Skyra-RL 保留 72.0% 和 74.5% BAcc 的官方时间戳，但这些配置保留了之前在第 1 节中确定的时间戳The fine-tuned MLLMs require a different interpretation. Their BAcc changes by at most 2.4 points, and FakeR decreases by 2.3–5.3 points across all five configurations. Skyra-SFT and Skyra-RL retain 72.0% and 74.5% BAcc with official timestamps, but these configurations preserve the timestamp prior identified in Section4.1.3。用帧索引替换时间戳将两个检查点减少到 53.7% BAcc。 BusterX++ 仅将 3.9% 的生成视频标记为假视频，同时保留 94.9% 的真实视频，达到 49.4% BAcc。因此，它们相对于源匹配参考的有限变化反映了已经很弱的视觉决策规则或强烈的类别偏好，而不是对人类欺骗性内容的可靠检测。. Replacing timestamps with frame indices reduces both checkpoints to 53.7% BAcc. BusterX+​+ reaches 49.4% BAcc by labeling only 3.9% of generated videos as fake while retaining 94.9% of real videos. Their limited changes from the source-matched reference therefore reflect an already weak visual decision rule or a strong class preference, not reliable detection of human-deceptive content.

解释和范围。Interpretation and scope.

RA-Bench-HumanProof 区分了三种失败模式：Gemini 在误导审阅者的视频中丢失了大部分虚假证据；传统探测器在人类选择之前和之后仍然很弱；较高的官方时间戳 Skyra 结果保留了先前的协议。因此，人为故障和探测器故障是重叠的，但它们并不等同。最重要的案例就在它们的交叉点上：在审查者看来反复出现真实的视频也从评估的探测器系列中收到了薄弱或不可靠的虚假证据。RA-Bench-HumanProof separates three failure patterns: Gemini loses much of its fake-side evidence on videos that mislead reviewers; traditional detectors remain weak before and after human selection; and the higher official-timestamp Skyra results retain a protocol prior. Human and detector failures therefore overlap, but they are not equivalent. The most consequential cases lie at their intersection: videos that repeatedly appear real to reviewers also receive weak or unreliable fake evidence from the evaluated detector families.

RA-Bench-HumanProof 是有条件构建的，不会取代完整的 RA-Bench。第 2 阶段的响应决定了成员资格，因此无法提供对保留视频的人类准确性的独立估计。它的源分布偏向 Seedance2.0 和 Kling，这激发了源匹配参考。 633 个生成的真实对还包括重复的真实锚；因此，区间估计应该对真实锚标识符重新采样，而不是将所有对视为独立的。RA-Bench-HumanProof is constructed conditionally and does not replace full RA-Bench. Stage 2 responses determine membership and therefore cannot provide an independent estimate of human accuracy on the retained videos. Its source distribution is skewed toward Seedance2.0 and Kling, which motivates the source-matched reference. The 633 generated–real pairs also include repeated real anchors; interval estimates should therefore resample the real-anchor identifier rather than treat all pairs as independent.

评估和不确定性。Evaluation and uncertainty.

对于每个传统检测器，我们分别计算每个生成源及其匹配的真实锚的度量，然后以相等的权重对九个源级值进行平均。微调 MLLM 检测器的分类指标遵循相同的协议。置信区间使用 2,000 个引导重复，按 L1 类别分层并按真实事件锚点聚类，随机种子为 20260718。所有报告的配置都包含所有六种条件下九个源的完整预测。我们在排除带有预先存在的右上方徽章的手动识别剪辑后重复分析。这种排除不会对结果产生实质性改变：在方法-条件单元中，AUC 的最大绝对变化为 2.8 个百分点，FakeR 的最大绝对变化为 4.3 个百分点。For each traditional detector, we compute metrics separately on each generation source and its matched real anchors, then average the nine source-level values with equal weight. Classification metrics for the fine-tuned MLLM detectors follow the same protocol. Confidence intervals use 2,000 bootstrap replicates, stratified by L1 category and clustered by real-event anchor, with random seed 20260718. All reported configurations contain complete predictions for the nine sources under all six conditions. We repeat the analysis after excluding manually identified clips with a pre-existing upper-right badge. This exclusion does not materially change the results: across method–condition cells, the largest absolute changes are 2.8 percentage points for AUC and 4.3 points for FakeR.

传统探测器灵敏度。Traditional-detector sensitivity.

在“完全”状态下，七个检测器的平均 AUC 下降了 4.2 个点，但该平均值掩盖了截然不同的响应。 ForgeLens 损失了 26.0 分，而 DeCoF 和 D3 分别获得了 2.4 分和 4.8 分。因此，检测器排序不稳定：T1 后与原始的 Spearman 相关性为 0.36，T1+T2 后为 0.07，T1+T3 后为 0.46，T1+T4 后为 0.29，Full 下为 0.07。单个检测器的这些增益并不表明在社会传播模拟下具有可靠的性能，因为 T@5% 始终保持较低水平，在 Full 下，七个检测器的平均值仅达到 2.8%。The seven-detector mean AUC decreases by 4.2 points under Full, but this average conceals sharply different responses. ForgeLens loses 26.0 points, whereas DeCoF and D3 gain 2.4 and 4.8 points. The detector ordering is consequently unstable: its Spearman correlation with Original is 0.36 after T1, 0.07 after T1+T2, 0.46 after T1+T3, 0.29 after T1+T4, and 0.07 under Full. These gains for individual detectors do not indicate reliable performance under the social dissemination simulation because T@5% remains low throughout, reaching only 2.8% for the seven-detector mean under Full.

微调 MLLM 灵敏度。Fine-tuned MLLM sensitivity.

T1 的孤立添加揭示了不同的故障模式。空间下采样产生最大的 FakeR 损失，将五种配置的平均值从 29.9% 降低到 7.9%。对于两种官方时间戳 Skyra 配置，转换为 8 fps 会使 BAcc 降低 11.7 和 12.9 点，而其帧索引控制则降低 3.4 和 2.4 点。这种差距与对时间表示的敏感性一致，而不仅仅是与视觉退化一致。新闻徽章将 FakeR 的平均值从 29.9% 降低到 14.0%，同时将 RealR 从 79.1% 提高到 88.5%，将预测转向The isolated additions to T1 reveal different failure patterns. Spatial downsampling produces the largest FakeR loss, reducing the five-configuration mean from 29.9% to 7.9%. Conversion to 8 fps lowers BAcc by 11.7 and 12.9 points for the two official-timestamp Skyra configurations, compared with 3.4 and 2.4 points for their frame-index controls. This gap is consistent with sensitivity to the temporal representation rather than only to visual degradation. The news badge lowers mean FakeR from 29.9% to 14.0% while increasing RealR from 79.1% to 88.5%, shifting predictions toward真实Real即使场景内容没有改变。在 Full 下，每个微调配置最多有 2.4% FakeR。even though the scene content is unchanged. Under Full, every fine-tuned configuration has at most 2.4% FakeR.
